title: Landau-Zener tunneling and quantum interference of Andreev states
summary: With the aid of a microscopic theory we derive an effective Hamiltonian that controls quantum dynamics of Andreev states in superconducting nanojunctions out of equilibrium. Resolving the corresponding Schrödinger-like equation we obtain the "wave functions" for Andreev levels and evaluate electric current across the junction in the presence of an external voltage bias. We demonstrate that quantum interference of Andreev states may yield pronounced coherent oscillations of the supercurrent as a function of the Josephson phase in junctions with barrier transmissions slightly below unity. Further implications of this novel effect are expected for junctions with diffusive barriers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微观理论推导出非平衡超导纳米结中安德烈夫态的有效哈密顿量，求解类薛定谔方程得到能级波函数并计算偏压下的电流，发现量子干涉可导致约瑟夫森相位的超流相干振荡。
AI.motivation: 研究非平衡条件下超导纳米结中安德烈夫态的量子动力学行为，以及量子干涉对超流的影响。
AI.method: 基于微观理论推导有效哈密顿量，求解类薛定谔方程得到安德烈夫能级的"波函数"，计算外偏压下的电流。
AI.result: 发现安德烈夫态的量子干涉可在势垒透射略低于1的结中产生约瑟夫森相位的超流相干振荡。
AI.conclusion: 该效应在扩散势垒结中也有潜在影响，揭示了非平衡超导结中新的量子干涉现象。

title: Superconducting dome and field-enhanced superconductivity of PLD synthesized Nd1-xEuxNiO2 thin films
summary: We report on the synthesis of infinite-layer Nd1-xEuxNiO2 (0<x<0.7) thin films using pulsed laser deposition (PLD) followed by topotactic reduction with CaH2. Resistivity measurements on these films reveal a superconducting dome within the doping range 0.2<x<0.5, which is wider than that achieved by molecular beam epitaxy and comparable to that obtained by chemical synthesis. The x=0.3 PLD film exhibits the optimal superconducting transition temperature Tc~31 K, much higher than those grown by other vacuum epitaxial techniques. This result indicates that PLD is an ideal approach for fabricating high-quality, high-Tc Nd1-xEuxNiO2 superconducting films. Magneto-transport measurements reveal robust field-enhanced and re-entrant superconductivity in both underdoped and overdoped regimes. At low temperatures just above the onset Tc, the Hall resistance exhibits nonlinear behavior, which may originate from magnetic impurity scattering. These results highlight the crucial role of magnetic rare-earth Eu2+ ions in producing the exotic physical properties of the infinite-layer nickelates.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了利用脉冲激光沉积（PLD）结合CaH₂拓扑还原合成无限层Nd₁₋ₓEuₓNiO₂薄膜，发现超导穹顶存在于x=0.2~0.5之间，最佳Tc~31 K，比分子束外延等方法更高，且PLD是制备高质量高Tc镍基超导薄膜的理想方法。磁场下的输运测量显示出稳健的场增强和重入超导现象，霍尔电阻的非线性行为可能源于磁性杂质散射，表明磁性稀土Eu²⁺离子在镍基超导奇特物性中起关键作用。
AI.motivation: 探索脉冲激光沉积（PLD）方法能否制备高质量、高临界温度的无限层镍基超导薄膜，并研究磁性稀土掺杂（Eu²⁺）对超导性能的影响，以突破目前真空外延技术的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用脉冲激光沉积（PLD）生长Nd₁₋ₓEuₓNiO₂薄膜，再通过CaH₂进行拓扑还原反应得到无限层结构；通过电阻率测量、磁输运测量（霍尔效应等）表征超导性能。
AI.result: 成功制备出x=0~0.7的无限层薄膜，超导穹顶位于x=0.2~0.5范围（比MBE更宽）；x=0.3时达到最佳Tc~31 K，高于其他真空外延技术；在欠掺杂和过掺杂区均观察到场增强和重入超导现象；霍尔电阻在Tc附近出现非线性行为。
AI.conclusion: PLD是制备高质量、高Tc无限层镍基超导膜的理想方法；磁性Eu²⁺离子对产生奇异物性（如场增强超导、霍尔非线性等）至关重要，为理解镍基超导机制提供了新视角。

title: Anomalous field evolution of the mixed-state linewidth in the second superconducting dome of LaFeAsO$_{1-x}M_x$ ($M={\rm F,H}$)
summary: We report a transverse-field muon-spin rotation/relaxation ($μ$SR) study of the internal-field distribution in the mixed state of LaFeAsO$_{0.89}$F$_{0.11}$ and LaFeAsO$_{0.75}$H$_{0.25}$, representative of the first (SC1) and second (SC2) superconducting domes of the LaFeAsO$_{1-x}M_x$ ($M={\rm F,H}$) family, respectively. Below the superconducting transition temperature $T_{\rm c}$, the linewidth of the internal-field distribution increases in both samples, indicating the formation of a vortex lattice. Above $T_{\rm c}$, the linewidth remains field dependent and increases approximately linearly with field, consistent with broadening of the powder spectrum caused by an anisotropic Knight shift. After subtraction of this normal-state contribution, the superconducting linewidth $σ_{\rm sc}$ exhibits qualitatively different field dependences in the two samples. At 4K, the SC1 ($x_{\rm F}=0.11$) sample shows the expected monotonic decrease with increasing field, whereas the SC2 ($x_{\rm H}=0.25$) sample develops a pronounced local maximum near 3T. A contour representation of $σ_{\rm sc}(T,H)$ further reveals a ridge of local maxima whose field position, $H_{σ,\max}(T)$, shifts to lower fields upon warming and disappears near $T_{\rm c}$. The anomalous field evolution observed in the SC2 sample is consistent with an additional field-induced contribution associated with enhanced Pauli-paramagnetic effects, highlighting the distinct electronic character of the two superconducting domes.

AI.tldr: 利用μSR技术研究LaFeAsO₁₋ₓMₓ（M=F,H）体系中第一个（SC1）和第二个（SC2）超导穹顶的混合态内场分布，发现SC2样品在3T附近出现反常的局域极大值，归因于增强的Pauli顺磁效应，揭示了两个超导穹顶不同的电子特性。
AI.motivation: 探究LaFeAsO₁₋ₓMₓ体系中两个超导穹顶（SC1和SC2）的混合态内场分布差异，揭示其不同的超导配对机制和电子特性。
AI.method: 使用横向场μ子自旋旋转/弛豫（μSR）技术，测量LaFeAsO₀.₈₉F₀.₁₁（SC1）和LaFeAsO₀.₇₅H₀.₂₅（SC2）在混合态下的内场分布线宽，扣除正常态贡献后分析超导线宽σₛ𝒸的温度和磁场依赖性。
AI.result: SC1样品的σₛ𝒸随磁场单调递减，符合预期；SC2样品在4K、3T附近出现σₛ𝒸的局域极大值，且该峰位随温度升高向低场移动，接近Tₓ时消失。
AI.conclusion: SC2样品中观察到的反常场依赖行为与场诱导的Pauli顺磁效应增强一致，表明两个超导穹顶具有截然不同的电子特性。

title: Effect of superconducting fluctuations on nonreciprocal dichroism and gyrotropy
summary: We study the spatially dispersive conductivity of a two-dimensional noncentrosymmetric superconductor, demonstrating that it acquires a nonreciprocal, odd-in-wavevector component from fluctuation-induced Cooper pairs above the critical temperature $T_c$. Utilizing time-dependent Ginzburg-Landau theory generalized to include particle-hole asymmetry and the cubic Lifshitz invariant of trigonal superconductors, we compute the Aslamazov-Larkin contribution to the gyrotropic conductivity in closed form, including its complete frequency dependence. The dissipative part describes nonreciprocal directional dichroism: it is odd in frequency and displays a nonmonotonic dependence, peaking at frequencies comparable to the decay rate of fluctuating Cooper pairs. Its Kramers-Kronig dual component describes gyrotropic birefringence, which remains finite in the static limit and is strongly enhanced as the temperature approaches $T_c$. Both effects require simultaneously broken inversion and time-reversal symmetries, are dependent on particle-hole asymmetry in close analogy to the fluctuation Hall effect, and trace to the same asymmetric Cooper-pair dispersion responsible for the superconducting diode effect and the giant magnetochiral anisotropy observed near $T_c$. This critical enhancement dominates over the smooth normal-state gyrotropy, which we evaluate for the same band model as a baseline. Finally, we frame our analysis within the context of gated transition metal dichalcogenides like MoS$_2$, discussing the implications for probing superconducting dynamics through nitrogen-vacancy-center quantum noise spectroscopy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维非中心对称超导体在临界温度以上由涨落诱导的库珀对产生的空间色散电导率，发现其具有非互易、奇波矢分量，并计算了Aslamazov-Larkin贡献的完整频率依赖关系，揭示了方向二色性和旋光双折射在临界点附近的增强效应。
AI.motivation: 理解非中心对称超导体中涨落诱导的非互易光学响应，特别是与超导二极管效应和巨磁手征各向异性相关的物理机制，为通过氮空位中心量子噪声谱探测超导动力学提供理论依据。
AI.method: 采用含时Ginzburg-Landau理论，引入粒子-空穴不对称性和三角超导体的立方Lifshitz不变量，解析计算了Aslamazov-Larkin贡献的旋光电导率，包括完整的频率依赖关系。
AI.result: 发现耗散部分（非互易方向二色性）在频率上与涨落库珀对衰变率可比时达到峰值；其Kramers-Kronig对偶分量（旋光双折射）在静态极限下有限，并在温度接近Tc时显著增强。两种效应都依赖于粒子-空穴不对称性，类似于涨落霍尔效应。
AI.conclusion: 非中心对称超导体的涨落效应在Tc附近主导了正常态旋光性，与超导二极管效应和巨磁手征各向异性同源，并可为基于氮空位中心的量子噪声谱探测超导涨落动力学提供新途径。

title: Stochastic simulations of nonlinear reaction-diffusion equations using an exponential integrator
summary: Stochastic simulations can be generated from deterministic reaction-diffusion equations by discretising in space and time and interpreting coefficients in the resulting system of discretised equations as probabilities governing movement and reaction events. In this paper, we present a novel variant of this approach for nonlinear reaction-diffusion equations that employs an exponential integrator when discretising in time. The proposed method yields valid probabilities, defined by the entries of appropriate matrix functions, without the strict conditions on the time step required by a commonly-employed time discretisation scheme. Simulation results presented for one and two dimensional Porous-Fisher type models demonstrate the veracity of the method across several test problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的随机模拟方法，通过使用指数积分器对非线性反应-扩散方程进行时空离散化，解决了传统方法对时间步长的严格限制，并在Porous-Fisher模型上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 克服传统时间离散化方案对时间步长的严格限制，使得随机模拟能够在更大的时间步长下保持概率的有效性。
AI.method: 采用指数积分器进行时间离散化，将矩阵函数的条目解释为控制运动和反应事件的概率，从而生成随机模拟。
AI.result: 在一维和二维Porous-Fisher类型模型上的仿真结果验证了该方法在多个测试问题中的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的指数积分器方法能在不严格要求时间步长的情况下产生有效的概率，为非线性反应-扩散方程的随机模拟提供了一种更灵活的方案。

title: A d-Electron Route to Heavy-Fermion-Like Superconductivity via Geometrical Frustration
summary: Heavy-fermion superconductors are mostly associated with f-electron materials with Kondo lattices, while known d-electron heavy-fermion-like systems are often linked to orbital-selective local moments, Hund-metal physics, or a charge-density-wave mechanism. Here we report Mo4PtGa17, a noncentrosymmetric itinerant d-electron superconductor with a geometrically frustrated breathing-pyrochlore Mo lattice. Thermodynamic, transport and NMR measurements reveal heavy-fermion-like behavior superconductivity and enhanced ferromagnetic spin fluctuations near a ferromagnetic instability. Theoretical calculations identify nearly flat bands, van Hove singularities and Kramers nodal lines near the Fermi energy, derived intrinsically from Mo-4d states and are robust against on-site electronic correlations. These results suggest that the geometrically frustrated lattice in Mo4PtGa17 generates an intriguing electronic structure that enhances the density of states, spin susceptibility and quasiparticle mass. Mo4PtGa17 therefore identifies a unique route to heavy-fermion-like superconductivity in d-electron materials through geometrical frustration. It also allows further investigations into superconductivity emerging from a correlated and spin-fluctuating state.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了Mo4PtGa17，一种具有几何阻挫的呼吸烧绿石钼晶格的非中心对称巡游d电子超导体，它表现出重费米子类超导行为和增强的铁磁自旋涨落，为d电子材料中的重费米子类超导提供了一条通过几何阻挫实现的新途径。
AI.motivation: 重费米子超导体通常与f电子材料和Kondo晶格相关，而已知的d电子重费米子系统则多与轨道选择局域矩、Hund金属物理或电荷密度波机制有关。本文旨在探索通过几何阻挫在d电子材料中实现重费米子类超导行为的新机制。
AI.method: 通过热力学、输运和核磁共振(NMR)测量，并结合第一性原理理论计算，对Mo4PtGa17的电子结构、自旋涨落和超导特性进行了系统研究。
AI.result: 发现Mo4PtGa17表现出重费米子类超导行为，并伴有增强的铁磁自旋涨落，接近铁磁不稳定性。理论计算在费米能级附近识别出近乎平带、van Hove奇点和Kramers节线，这些源自Mo-4d态且对在位电子关联具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 几何阻挫的晶格在Mo4PtGa17中产生了独特的电子结构，增强了态密度、自旋磁化率和准粒子质量，从而为d电子材料中的重费米子类超导提供了一条通过几何阻挫实现的新路径，为后续研究从关联和自旋涨落态涌现的超导性提供了平台。

title: Geometric Universality and Thermodynamic Microstructure of Real Fluids in a Unified Entropic Framework
summary: We introduce a unified entropic framework for real fluids that encompasses the van der Waals, Berthelot, Redlich Kwong, and Peng Robinson equations of state within a common thermodynamic description. The corresponding microscopic interactions are then explored using Geometrothermodynamics, GTD, through the scalar curvature $mathcal{R}$ of the equilibrium manifold. We show that curvature singularities accurately reproduce macroscopic critical phenomena, while vanishing curvature $\mathcal{R}=0$ identifies specific thermodynamic states where attractive and repulsive intermolecular forces effectively balance. Furthermore, we introduce a set of dimensionless critical-amplitude ratios $Q^i_{j}$, which reveal universal geometric features of the critical regime. Although individual critical amplitudes exhibit a logarithmic dependence on the system size, these invariant ratios organize different molecular species according to the strength of criticality and encode universal scaling features, suggesting their potential as robust classification parameters. Finally, employing Bayesian inference and Markov Chain Monte Carlo, MCMC methods, we statistically reconstruct the zero-curvature curves. The posterior distributions support the consistency of the geometric scaling behavior, demonstrating that the GTD manifold encodes non-trivial information about the underlying thermodynamical models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的熵框架，将范德瓦尔斯、Berthelot、Redlich-Kwong和Peng-Robinson四种状态方程纳入同一热力学描述，并利用几何热力学(GTD)的标量曲率分析微观相互作用，发现曲率奇点对应宏观临界现象，零曲率对应分子间引斥力平衡点。同时引入无量纲临界振幅比，结合贝叶斯推断和MCMC方法，验证了GTD流形的几何标度行为与热力学模型的一致性。
AI.motivation: 将多种真实流体状态方程统一在一个共同的热力学框架下，并通过几何热力学(GTD)的曲率分析揭示其微观相互作用与宏观临界现象之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 基于统一熵框架将四种状态方程纳入相同热力学描述；利用GTD标量曲率R分析平衡流形；引入无量纲临界振幅比Q^i_j；采用贝叶斯推断和MCMC统计重建零曲率曲线。
AI.result: 曲率奇点准确复现宏观临界现象；R=0对应分子间引斥力平衡的热力学状态；临界振幅比对系统尺寸呈对数依赖但比值具有普适标度特征；贝叶斯后验分布支持GTD几何标度行为的一致性。
AI.conclusion: GTD流形编码了底层热力学模型的非平凡信息，所引入的无量纲临界振幅比可作为稳健的分类参数，对不同分子物种按临界强度进行组织。

title: Staggered Potential and Elliptical Light Driven Topological Phase Transitions in $α$-$\mathcal{T}_{3}$ Lattice
summary: We theoretically investigate the influence of hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) on the electronic properties of an $α$-$\mathcal{T}_{3}$ lattice driven by an off-resonant elliptically polarized light field. The staggered potential $M$ breaks the sublattice inversion symmetry, transforming the initial semimetal into a trivial insulator with Chern number $C=0$. We identify a fundamental geometric singularity at $α=1/\sqrt{2}$, independent of $M$, below which no finite drive can close the lower band gap, creating a stable topological window where conduction--flat band inversion yields a Chern insulator with $C=1$. Above this critical value the lower gap closes with finite intensity, allowing a transition from $C=1$ to $C=2$ as the dice limit ($α=1$) is approached. The topological phases are characterized by quantized anomalous Hall plateaus at $σ_{xy}=e^2/h$ ($C=1$) and $σ_{xy}=2e^2/h$ ($C=2$), with each valley contributing exactly $\frac{1}{2}e^2/h$. The $C=1$ plateau remains robust from $0$ K to $300$ K, while $C=2$ requires $T<100$ K due to its narrower gap. A highly asymmetric thermoelectric Seebeck response further serves as an experimental fingerprint of each phase, providing a realistic framework for realizing stable high-Chern-number phases in substrate-supported $α$-$\mathcal{T}_{3}$ materials.

AI.tldr: 本文理论研究了椭圆偏振光场下h-BN基底对α-T₃晶格电子性质的影响，发现α=1/√2处存在几何奇异性，可实现稳定的高Chern数拓扑相，并给出了量子化反常霍尔电导和热电Seebeck响应的实验特征。
AI.motivation: 探索六方氮化硼(h-BN)基底与椭圆偏振光场共同作用下α-T₃晶格的电子性质，揭示稳定高Chern数拓扑相的物理机制与实验可观测特征。
AI.method: 采用理论分析方法，引入交错势M打破子格反演对称性，施加非共振椭圆偏振光场驱动，研究α参数对能隙闭合与拓扑相变的影响。
AI.result: 发现α=1/√2处存在几何奇异性，低于该值形成稳定C=1 Chern绝缘体；高于该值可实现C=1到C=2的转变。量子化反常霍尔电导分别为σ_xy=e²/h和2e²/h。C=1相在0-300K保持稳健，C=2相需T<100K。热电Seebeck响应可作为各相的实验指纹。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在基底支撑的α-T₃材料中实现稳定高Chern数拓扑相提供了理论框架，并给出了明确的实验可观测信号。

title: Quantum Thermodynamics of Electron Transport along Chains of Redox Centers
summary: Intramolecular electron transport in biological systems is typically described as a diffusive hopping process, according to the semi-classical rate theories of Marcus and Hopfield combined with classical Pauli-type master equations. However, the possibility that non-trivial quantum mechanical effects could play a functional role in the transport dynamics in certain biomolecular processes has attracted increasing attention. Here, we extend the quantum mechanical model of open system dynamics by the Lindblad equation to a key biological component, the long chains of redox centers based on iron-sulfur clusters or heme groups that are widespread in many biological organisms, where they realize the cellular respiration. This approach allows to explore a wide range of physical parameters, showing key features of electron transport in these multi-domain protein structures. We pay particular attention to heat and entropy transfer between the electrons and the protein bath, which constitutes a benchmark of physical realism for the models. Electron currents, average transfer times and relative efficiency of the transport process are also explicitly characterized.

AI.tldr: 本文采用Lindblad方程这一量子开放系统动力学模型，研究生物呼吸链中铁硫簇/血红素基团构成的电子传输链，分析电流、传输时间、效率及热熵传递等关键物理特征。
AI.motivation: 传统Marcus/Hopfield半经典速率理论将生物系统内分子间电子传输描述为扩散跳跃过程，但量子力学效应可能在部分生物过程中发挥功能性作用，作者因此希望用量子开放系统模型探索这一可能性。
AI.method: 将Lindblad方程的量子开放系统动力学模型扩展到基于铁硫簇或血红素基团的氧化还原中心长链，通过调节多种物理参数进行模拟分析。
AI.result: 展示了多结构域蛋白质中电子传输的关键特征，明确量化了电子电流、平均传输时间、传输相对效率以及电子与蛋白质浴之间的热熵传递。
AI.conclusion: 量子开放系统模型能够有效描述生物呼吸链中的电子传输过程，热熵传递可作为模型物理真实性的基准，量子效应可能在此类生物过程中具有功能性作用。

title: SlaKoNet-VQD: A universal Slater-Koster tight-binding Hamiltonian for variational quantum band-structure calculations on near-term hardware
summary: Variational quantum algorithms such as VQE and VQD are promising for near-term electronic structure calculations, but for periodic solids their reach is limited by the cost of building a faithful second-quantized Hamiltonian, typically via DFT plus Wannierization or hand-fit tight-binding parameters. SlaKoNet addresses this by combining deep learning with the Slater-Koster tight-binding formalism to fit hopping and overlap parameters across 65 elements, enabling deterministic Hamiltonian construction for any crystal built from these elements. Here we couple a SlaKoNet model trained on JARVIS-TBmBJ with a Qiskit-based VQD algorithm, replacing costly Hamiltonian construction with a universal neural Hamiltonian generator. The resulting SlaKoNet-VQD workflow is structure-agnostic, differentiable, and suited to high-throughput bandstructure screening. We benchmark on silicon, recovering the full eight-band structure along the standard k-path with mean absolute deviation of 1.78 meV from exact diagonalization on a 3-qubit simulator, and extend to five conventional superconductors (Al, Ta, Nb, V, ZrN) with similar accuracy. We demonstrate execution on IBM Quantum hardware for a k-point ground-state calculation on aluminum (MAE ~0.37 eV). We further promote the Hamiltonian to a correlated Hubbard model solved via dynamical mean-field theory, recovering weakening correlations across group-5 metals and strong quasiparticle renormalization in La2CuO4, identifying the impurity problem as a natural quantum solver target. This pipeline enables high-throughput VQA benchmarking across the periodic table and gradient-based ansatz-Hamiltonian co-optimization for materials discovery. Web app: https://atomgpt.org/quantum.

AI.tldr: 该研究将深度学习驱动的SlaKoNet紧束缚模型与变分量子算法(VQD)相结合，构建了SlaKoNet-VQD工作流，实现了无需DFT预计算的周期性材料能带结构高效量子计算，并在硅、五种超导体及关联材料体系中验证了其准确性，同时展示了在IBM量子硬件上的执行与向Hubbard模型的拓展。
AI.motivation: 变分量子算法在周期固体电子结构计算中受限于构建忠实二次量子化哈密顿量的高昂成本（通常依赖DFT加Wannier化或人工拟合紧束缚参数），亟需一种普适、高效、可微的哈密顿量生成方法。
AI.method: 将基于深度学习的SlaKoNet模型（在JARVIS-TBmBJ数据集上训练，覆盖65种元素）与Qiskit平台的VQD算法耦合，用通用神经哈密顿生成器替代传统昂贵哈密顿量构建流程，形成结构无关、可微分的SlaKoNet-VQD工作流。
AI.result: 在硅的八能带结构计算中，与精确对角化相比平均绝对偏差仅1.78 meV（3量子比特模拟器）；在五种常规超导体（Al, Ta, Nb, V, ZrN）上取得类似精度；在IBM量子硬件上完成铝的k点基态计算（MAE ~0.37 eV）；进一步将哈密顿量推广到关联Hubbard模型，通过DMFT成功恢复第5族金属的弱关联特征及La2CuO4的强准粒子重整化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流实现了高通量变分量子算法基准测试、梯度驱动的哈密顿-拟设协同优化，为材料发现提供了可跨周期表部署的量子计算框架，并指出杂质问题可成为量子求解器的自然目标。

title: Soft point-contact Andreev reflection spectroscopy in a palm-type cubic anvil-pressure cell
summary: We have implemented soft point-contact Andreev reflection spectroscopy (PCARS) in a palm-type cubic anvil pressure cell by combining a substrate anchoring strategy with an external wire-splitting technique. This design enables the stable formation of multiple point contact junctions under hydrostatic pressures up to 15 GPa. Benchmark measurements on the elemental superconductor Nb demonstrate high reproducibility and yield a zero-temperature superconducting gap with a gap ratio of 3.3. We further apply this technique to the Kagome metal superconductor CsCr3Sb5 and the bilayer nickelate superconductor La2PrNi2O7. Pronounced zero-bias conductance peaks are observed, and their evolution with temperature, magnetic field and applied pressure is investigated, together with the superconducting gap magnitude and possible pairing symmetries. These measurements provide spectroscopic evidence consistent with unconventional superconductivity in these materials. Our work establishes a robust experimental platform that bridges macroscopic electrical transport and microscopic spectroscopic probes, opening a new avenue for investigating pairing symmetry in a wide range of pressure-induced unconventional superconductors.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种在立方砧压机中实现软点接触安德烈夫反射谱（PCARS）的技术，通过在衬底锚定和外部分线技术，可在15 GPa静水压下稳定形成多个点接触结。在Nb超导体上验证了高重复性，并应用于Kagome金属CsCr3Sb5和双层镍酸盐La2PrNi2O7超导体，观测到零偏压电导峰等非常规超导特征。该工作为高压下超导配对对称性研究提供了新的实验平台。
AI.motivation: 目前高压下超导配对对称性的谱学探测手段有限，缺乏一种既能承受高压又能提供高质量安德烈夫反射谱的实验平台。本文旨在填补高压超导电性研究中宏观电输运与微观谱学探测之间的技术空白。
AI.method: 采用衬底锚定策略与外部分线技术相结合，在手掌型立方砜压机中实现了软点接触安德烈夫反射谱测量。该方法可在高达15 GPa的静水压下稳定形成多个点接触结，实现对超导能隙和配对对称性的原位谱学表征。
AI.result: 在Nb超导体上获得零温超导能隙及3.3的能隙比，验证了技术的高重复性。在CsCr3Sb5和La2PrNi2O7中观测到显著的零偏压电导峰，并系统研究了这些特征随温度、磁场和压力的演化，获得了超导能隙大小及可能的配对对称性信息。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了连接宏观电输运与微观谱学探测的稳健实验平台，为研究压力诱导非常规超导体的配对对称性开辟了新途径。

title: Functional Expansion Tallies of Matrix Operators for Prediction for Integrated Autocorrelation Time in Batch Monte Carlo: an Analytic 2D Scattering Chain Benchmark
comment: 4 pages, 4 figures, submitted to 2026 ANS Annual Conference
summary: We investigate functional expansion tallies as a reduced-basis representation for predicting inter-cycle correlations in Monte Carlo transport. Using an analytic two-dimensional isotropic scattering-chain benchmark with reflective boundaries, we compare a conventional discrete-cell Markov-chain estimator with a Galerkin reduced-order model built directly from Monte Carlo tallies of basis-function products. The reduced model estimates integrated autocorrelation time without first constructing a large discrete transition matrix. For the benchmark problem, the cosine basis converges rapidly to the exact result, while polynomial bases show systematic convergence with increasing order. Compared with discrete binning, the reduced-basis approach achieves lower bias at comparable or lower solve cost, suggesting that functional-expansion representations can provide an efficient path toward correlation prediction, uncertainty quantification, and future variance-reduction methods in Monte Carlo criticality calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将函数展开统计量作为降阶基表示，用于预测蒙特卡罗输运中的循环间相关性。通过解析二维各向同性散射链基准与反射边界，比较了传统离散单元马尔可夫链估计器与基于蒙特卡罗统计量的伽辽金降阶模型。降阶模型无需构建大型离散转移矩阵即可估计积分自相关时间。余弦基快速收敛到精确解，多项式基随阶数增加系统收敛。相比离散分箱，降阶基方法在相当或更低的求解成本下实现更低偏差，表明函数展开表示可为蒙特卡罗临界计算中的相关性预测、不确定度量化及未来方差缩减方法提供高效路径。
AI.motivation: 在蒙特卡罗临界计算中，预测循环间相关性对于不确定度量化和方差缩减至关重要，但传统离散方法需要构建大型转移矩阵，计算成本高昂。本文旨在探索一种更高效的降阶基表示方法。
AI.method: 采用解析二维各向同性散射链基准问题，比较了传统离散单元马尔可夫链估计器与基于蒙特卡罗统计量的伽辽金降阶模型。使用余弦基和多项式基作为函数展开表示，直接估计积分自相关时间。
AI.result: 余弦基快速收敛到精确结果，多项式基随阶数增加系统收敛。相比离散分箱，降阶基方法在相当或更低的求解成本下实现了更低的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 函数展开表示可为蒙特卡罗临界计算中的相关性预测、不确定度量化及未来方差缩减方法提供高效路径。

title: Anyons and Inherently Complex F-symbols
summary: Anyons in $2+1$ dimensions are not only characterized by exotic braiding statistics but also by intricate fusion properties. Two anyons may fuse into multiple topological charge sectors, and associativity of fusing three anyons to produce a fixed charge sector is governed by $F$-symbols. While braiding invariants, such as the modular data, are typically complex valued, a complete description of general anyon models requires understanding the arithmetic properties of its fusion associativity data as well. The $F$-symbols for many of the most common $2+1$d topological orders, including all Abelian anyon models as well as Fibonacci and Ising anyons, can be made real valued. We show this phenomenon is not universal by exhibiting braided fusion categories whose $F$-symbols cannot be made real. We call such $F$-symbols \lq\lq inherently complex." The examples we study lack a charge-conjugation symmetry and our results are therefore consistent with the converse of a statement proved in a companion work linking real $F$-symbols in braided fusion categories with the existence of a suitable charge-conjugation symmetry. We analyse the smallest-rank braided fusion categories we know of with inherently complex $F$-symbols: ${\rm Rep}(\mathbb{Z}_7\rtimes\mathbb{Z}_3)$ and ${\rm Rep}(\mathbb{Z}_5\rtimes\mathbb{Z}_4)$. Consequently, the corresponding $\mathcal Z({\rm Rep}(\mathbb{Z}_7\rtimes\mathbb{Z}_3))$ and $\mathcal Z({\rm Rep}(\mathbb{Z}_5\rtimes\mathbb{Z}_4))$ anyon models also have inherently complex $F$-symbols. Our presentation connects these examples with recent results on classifying anyons beyond modular data.

AI.tldr: 本文证明存在一些任意子模型（如Rep(Z₇⋊Z₃)和Rep(Z₅⋊Z₄)及其中心化范畴），其F-符号无法通过基变换变为实数，即"固有复数"F-符号，打破了常见任意子模型（阿贝尔、Fibonacci、Ising）F-符号可实化的普遍认知。
AI.motivation: 任意子的完整描述不仅需要模数据（braiding不变量），还需要理解融合结合性数据（F-符号）的算术性质。此前常见任意子模型的F-符号均可实化，作者想探究这一现象是否普遍成立。
AI.method: 通过研究缺乏电荷共轭对称性的辫子融合范畴，特别是Rep(Z₇⋊Z₃)和Rep(Z₅⋊Z₄)这两个最小秩的例子，证明其F-符号固有复数，并与伴生论文中关于实F-符号与电荷共轭对称性等价的结论相呼应。
AI.result: 发现了具有固有复数F-符号的任意子模型，打破了F-符号均可实化的先验认知；这些模型恰好缺乏电荷共轭对称性，与理论预期一致。
AI.conclusion: 并非所有任意子模型的F-符号都能实化，存在固有复数的F-符号；这一发现对超越模数据分类任意子具有重要意义，且实F-符号的存在性与电荷共轭对称性密切相关。

title: Revisiting the non-equilibrium phase transitions of the continuous-trait Axelrod model
summary: We investigate the non-equilibrium phase transitions of the continuous-trait Axelrod model, an agent-based framework where individual culture is represented by a vector of $F$ continuous features confined to the interval $(0,1)$. Local interactions are governed by a metric similarity threshold $d$, which acts as a continuous control parameter of social tolerance. The dynamics inevitably freeze into one of two absorbing configuration classes: an ordered, homogeneous monocultural state at high tolerance, or a highly fragmented, disordered state at low tolerance. While previous studies characterized the transition as hybrid based on the continuous behavior of the domain density $μ$ alongside a discontinuous jump in the largest domain fraction $ρ$, we show that this apparent continuity is an artifact of severe finite-size masking effects. By shifting the methodological focus to the scaling of the median $\tildeμ$ and analyzing the full probability distributions $P(μ)$, we unveil a clear bimodal structure with disjoint maxima across independent simulation runs. Our results reveal that for $F=2$, the system undergoes a genuinely hybrid transition in the contemporary sense, featuring a tiny but finite latent jump ($μ_c \approx 0.089$) at the critical threshold $d_c \approx 0.0784$ while scaling toward it from below via a non-analytical power law with a mean-field exponent $β\approx 1/2$. Conversely, for $F=3$, the higher trait-space dimensionality suppresses local fluctuations, yielding a traditional, non-hybrid first-order transition. We apply this framework to the alternative discrete Poisson variant of the model, successfully confirming its known continuous transition for $F=2$ and discontinuous, non-hybrid transition for $F=3$, thereby establishing a unified characterization of phase transitions in Axelrod-like systems.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了连续特征Axelrod模型的非平衡相变。通过分析中位数缩放和分布双峰结构，发现F=2时存在真正的混合相变（潜热跳跃约0.089，临界指数β≈1/2），而F=3时由于高维抑制涨落，表现为传统一级相变。该框架同样成功统一描述了离散Poisson变体模型的相变类型。
AI.motivation: 前人研究认为Axelrod模型的相变是混合型的，但作者指出这其实是有限尺寸掩蔽效应造成的假象。为了更准确地刻画该模型的相变本质，尤其是区分连续性与不连续性，本文引入了中位数标度和完整概率分布分析的方法。
AI.method: 采用连续特征Axelrod模型（F维向量，值域(0,1)），通过相似性阈值d控制社会容忍度。关注中位数μ̃的标度行为，分析完整概率分布P(μ)的双峰结构，并计算潜热跳跃和临界指数β。
AI.result: 对于F=2，在临界阈值d_c≈0.0784处存在微小但有限的潜热跳跃μ_c≈0.089，从下方逼近时呈现幂律标度，β≈1/2，属于真正的混合相变。对于F=3，由于更高维度抑制局部波动，表现为传统非混合的一级相变。在离散Poisson变体中同样验证了F=2为连续相变，F=3为不连续非混合相变。
AI.conclusion: 该工作澄清了Axelrod模型相变类型的争议，建立了统一的相变表征框架。混合相变需要同时满足潜热跳跃和临界幂律行为两个条件，而高特征维度会导致相变从混合型退化为传统一级相变。

title: Evidence for spin swapping from modulation of transverse resistance in magnetic heterostructures with Rashba interface
summary: We investigate the transverse response under the out-of-plane magnetic field for magnetic heterostructures with Cu/Bi2O3 or Ag/Bi2O3 Rashba interfaces. We detect opposite contributions on the transverse resistance by the Cu/Bi2O3 and the Ag/Bi2O3 interfaces, which interestingly coincide well with the opposite signs of the spin/charge interconversion from the two interfaces. We suppose the opposite influences on the transverse resistance feature spin swapping occurrence of the converted spin current. The transverse spin flow emerges due to the spin swapping in both Cu and Ag layer, but the direction of the spin flow is opposed dependent on the spin direction of the converted spin current.

AI.tldr: 研究Cu/Bi2O3和Ag/Bi2O3 Rashba界面的横向响应，发现两者对横向电阻的贡献相反，与自旋/电荷相互转换的符号一致，推测存在自旋交换效应。
AI.motivation: 探究Rashba界面中自旋/电荷相互转换对横向输运的影响，揭示不同金属层（Cu和Ag）中自旋交换效应的差异。
AI.method: 在外加垂直磁场下，测量Cu/Bi2O3和Ag/Bi2O3 Rashba界面异质结构的横向电阻，比较两种界面的自旋/电荷转换符号与横向响应的关系。
AI.result: Cu/Bi2O3和Ag/Bi2O3对横向电阻的贡献方向相反，且与各自自旋/电荷相互转换的符号一致；推测自旋交换效应在两者中产生方向相反的自旋流。
AI.conclusion: 横向电阻的反向贡献源于自旋交换效应产生的横向自旋流方向相反，后者取决于转换自旋电流的自旋方向。

title: Q-Score: A Quantum-Native Scoring Function for Molecular Docking
summary: Molecular docking predicts how a small molecule binds to a protein and is a key bottleneck in drug discovery. Classical scoring functions sum empirical pairwise contacts, blind to quantum-mechanical effects like orbital charge transfer that govern binding specificity. We introduce Q-Score, encoding GNN-predicted orbital donor-acceptor energies into a weighted graph and scoring binding by solving a maximum-weight vertex clique problem via Digitized-Counterdiabatic QAOA. Each interaction anchor maps to one qubit and compatibility constraints become edges. Across 11 protein targets, DC-QAOA recovers the exact optimum on 8 at 10 qubits. On 1000 AI-generated molecules, Q-Score is orthogonal to classical scoring with Spearman rho of 0.05, driven by orbital quality with rho of 0.90, and free of molecular-weight bias, enriching for strong orbital interactions at twice the random rate. DC-QAOA achieves a mean approximation ratio of 0.94 with 52 percent exact. Execution of 1000 circuits on IBM Eagle confirms 6-qubit solvability on NISQ hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出Q-Score，利用GNN预测的轨道供体-受体能量构建加权图，通过Digitized-Counterdiabatic QAOA求解最大权重顶点团问题来打分分子对接，在量子硬件上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 经典打分函数仅依赖经验性成对接触，忽略了量子力学效应（如轨道电荷转移）对结合特异性的关键影响。
AI.method: 将GNN预测的轨道供体-受体能量编码为加权图，将每个相互作用锚点映射为一个量子比特，兼容性约束作为边，通过DC-QAOA求解最大权重顶点团问题来获得结合分数。
AI.result: 在11个蛋白靶标中，DC-QAOA在8个上恢复精确最优解（10量子比特）。在1000个AI生成分子上，Q-Score与经典打分正交（Spearman rho=0.05），与轨道质量高度相关（rho=0.90），无分子量偏差，强轨道相互作用富集率是随机两倍。DC-QAOA平均近似比0.94，52%精确。IBM Eagle上执行1000个电路验证了6量子比特的NISQ可解性。
AI.conclusion: Q-Score成功将量子力学效应引入分子对接打分，与经典方法互补，且可在NISQ量子硬件上运行，为量子计算在药物发现中的应用提供了可行方案。

title: Approximate explicit formulas for Stoner-Wohlfarth hysteresis loops
summary: Approximate explicit formulas for the hysteresis loops in the Stoner-Wohlfarth model are derived. We consider the hysteresis loops both for a single particle with a fixed easy-axis direction and for an ensemble of particles with randomly oriented anisotropy axes. The physical assumption used to derive the formulas is that the particle magnetic moment lies in the vicinity of the easy axis or the external field direction, at low and high fields, respectively. Surprisingly, the low-field formula is approximately valid even near the Stoner-Wohlfarth astroid, where the reduced magnetic field h0 is not very small. The general piecewise formula is obtained by an appropriate matching of the functions defined on different intervals of the magnetic field, which are chosen to maximize the formula accuracy. For the averaged hysteresis loop, the maximal, but reasonably small, deviation of our formula from numerically calculated magnetization occurs at h0 = 0.5, which corresponds to the sharp change in magnetization slope.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了Stoner-Wohlfarth模型中磁滞回线的近似显式公式，分别针对单粒子和随机取向各向异性轴的粒子集合。通过低场和高场近似匹配，得到分段公式，平均磁化偏差在h0=0.5处最大但较小。
AI.motivation: 为Stoner-Wohlfarth模型提供简洁的近似显式解析公式，避免数值计算的复杂性，同时保证足够高的精度。
AI.method: 基于物理假设（磁矩在低场时靠近易轴、高场时靠近外场方向），推导低场和高场近似公式；通过合理匹配不同场区间的函数，获得分段显式公式，以最大化精度。
AI.result: 低场公式即使在接近Stoner-Wohlfarth小行星面（h0不小）时仍近似有效；对平均磁滞回线，公式与数值计算的最大偏差出现在h0=0.5处，偏差较小。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的近似显式公式在保持简洁性的同时，对单粒子和随机取向粒子集合的磁滞回线均有良好精度，适用于h0=0.5附近外的广泛场范围。

title: Evolution from an acoustic-plasmon-mediated superconductivity to an acoustic-phonon-mediated superconductivity in bilayers
summary: Motivated by recent developments in van der Waals heterostructures, we revisit the acoustic plasmon mechanism of superconductivity in bilayer systems composed of a light layer (LL) and heavy layer (HL) by employing Eliashberg theory. The exchange of virtual plasmons in the HL can lead to a retarded in time attractive interaction between electrons of LL that we model through the screened interaction in the bilayer system within the random phase approximation. We explore the evolution from acoustic plasmon mediated superconductivity to phonon mediated superconductivity by studying the evolution of $T_c$ as the HL mass is increased by a few orders of magnitude compared with the electronic mass in LL. The lower HL mass corresponds to the bilayer acoustic plasmon, while the latter regime is closer to the Born-Oppenheimer regime of acoustic phonon mediated strongly retarded pairing. The heavy HL mass limit is known to obey Migdal's theorem by virtue of the small ratio of the two individual layer masses. We study the nonadiabatic effects for the arbitrary mass ratio with no small parameter systematically by using a frequency cut off in the Eliashberg theory, providing $T_c$ as a function of this cut off.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Eliashberg理论重新审视了由轻层和重层组成的双层系统中的声学等离激元超导机制，研究了从声学等离激元介导超导到声子介导超导的演化过程，并分析了不同质量比下的非绝热效应。
AI.motivation: 受范德瓦尔斯异质结最新发展的启发，重新研究双层系统中声学等离激元的超导机制，特别是从轻层-重层系统出发，探索等离激元介导超导与声子介导超导之间的连续演化。
AI.method: 采用Eliashberg理论，利用随机相位近似（RPA）描述双层系统中的屏蔽相互作用，通过频率截断方法系统研究任意质量比下的非绝热效应，并追踪超导转变温度Tc随重层质量变化（从轻质量到接近Born-Oppenheimer极限）的演化。
AI.result: 发现随着重层质量从与轻层相当增加到远大于轻层，超导机制从声学等离激元介导逐渐过渡到声子介导的强延迟配对；在重层质量极限下，系统遵从Migdal定理；通过频率截断得到了Tc随截断频率变化的函数关系。
AI.conclusion: 双层系统中的超导机制存在从等离激元到声子的连续演化，且通过频率截断方法可以有效处理任意质量比下的非绝热效应，为理解范德瓦尔斯异质结中的超导现象提供了理论框架。

title: Understanding Chemical Short-Range Order in CoNiV via Mode Analysis
comment: 4 pages, 6 figures, submitted to 2026 ANS Annual Conference
summary: We analyze chemical short-range order in equiatomic fcc NiCoV using molecular-dynamics snapshots generated with a machine-learned interatomic potential. Radial distribution functions identify stable coordination shells, while shell-resolved Warren-Cowley parameters and bond probabilities reveal continued chemical ordering after the radial structure has largely converged. The dominant signal is V-V avoidance in the first shell and V-V enrichment in the second shell, consistent with an L1$_2$-like local ordering tendency, while the third-shell response remains weak. Lagged Jensen-Shannon diagnostics show that bond statistics relax more slowly than the RDF. Principal component analysis of per-replica-centered bond probabilities resolves three collective modes: a V-sublattice ordering amplitude, a Ni-Co redistribution mode, and a Co-V exchange-like mode. These results show that scalar RDF convergence can miss slow chemical relaxation, and that shell-resolved bond statistics provide a compact route for tracking SRO development in multicomponent alloys.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机器学习势的分子动力学模拟，分析了等原子比fcc NiCoV合金中的化学短程序，发现径向分布函数收敛后化学有序仍在演化，V-V在第一壳层规避、第二壳层富集，且键统计量比RDF弛豫更慢，主成分分析识别出三种集体有序模式。
AI.motivation: 研究等原子比fcc NiCoV合金中的化学短程序（SRO）演化，因为传统的径向分布函数（RDF）可能无法捕捉到缓慢的化学弛豫过程，需要更精细的统计工具来追踪多组分合金中的有序化发展。
AI.method: 使用机器学习势生成分子动力学快照，通过径向分布函数识别配位壳层，利用壳层分辨的Warren-Cowley参数和键概率分析化学有序，引入Lagged Jensen-Shannon诊断比较弛豫速率，并采用主成分分析（PCA）提取集体有序模式。
AI.result: V-V在第一壳层规避、第二壳层富集，呈现L1₂-like局部有序趋势；第三壳层响应较弱。Lagged Jensen-Shannon显示键统计量比RDF弛豫更慢。PCA识别出三个集体模式：V亚晶格有序振幅、Ni-Co再分布模式、Co-V交换模式。
AI.conclusion: 标量RDF收敛可能遗漏缓慢的化学弛豫，壳层分辨的键统计量是追踪多组分合金中SRO发展的紧凑有效方法。

title: Pinwheel-shaped bound triplet pairs in the magnetization plateaus of SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$
summary: The sequence of magnetization plateaus at 1/8, 2/15, 1/6, 1/4, 1/3, 2/5, and 1/2 of the saturation observed in SrCu$_2$(BO$_3$)$_2$ remained a puzzle until tensor-networks-based numerical simulations suggested that the low-magnetization plateaus are stabilized as Wigner crystals of spin-2 bound states, and not as one of the standard configurations (semiclassical up-down, or crystals of triplets). We report on $^{63,65}$Cu nuclear magnetic resonance spectra up to 41.9 T: Based on constraints deduced from the 1/3 plateau, we show that the spectra in the 1/8 and 2/15 plateaus indeed agree with the prediction for the spin-2 bound states, while being incompatible with a crystal of triplets. This adds the formation of Wigner crystals of bound states as an alternative fundamental paradigm in the theory of magnetization plateaus.

AI.tldr: 通过核磁共振实验验证了SrCu₂(BO₃)₂中低磁化平台是由自旋-2束缚态形成的维格纳晶体稳定存在的，而非传统三态子晶体或半经典上-下构型。
AI.motivation: 解决SrCu₂(BO₃)₂中观察到的多个磁化平台（1/8, 2/15, 1/6, 1/4, 1/3, 2/5, 1/2）的微观机制这一长期谜题，特别验证低场平台是否由自旋-2束缚态的维格纳晶体稳定。
AI.method: 对SrCu₂(BO₃)₂进行⁶³,⁶⁵Cu核磁共振谱测量，磁场高达41.9 T；利用1/3平台的约束条件，对比1/8和2/15平台的实验数据与自旋-2束缚态和三态子晶体的理论预测。
AI.result: 在1/8和2/15平台上，核磁共振谱与自旋-2束缚态的预测一致，而与三态子晶体模型不兼容。
AI.conclusion: 束缚态维格纳晶体的形成是磁化平台理论中一种新的基本范式。

title: A Cascade of Volterra-Operator BBP Transitions in a Correlated Wigner Matrix
summary: We study a Wigner-type random matrix in which the off-diagonal correlation between entries is generated by a random factor shared among all entries in a given row and column, with the coupling strength held fixed as the matrix size grows. Although the bulk spectral moments remain those of the pure semicircle law, we show that the underlying correlation matrix decomposes into a vanishing bulk together with a countable family of outlier eigenvalues that, at fixed rank $k$, converge to the singular values of a compact Volterra (cumulative-sum) integral operator -- obtained in closed form via the classical Karhunen--Loève expansion of Brownian motion and confirmed numerically to better than one percent across the top twenty such values. Each singular value drives an independent Baik--Ben Arous--Péché (BBP) transition as the coupling strength increases, producing an evenly spaced, discrete hierarchy of critical points -- rather than a single transition -- at each of which one further eigenvalue detaches from the semicircle edge, in close agreement with direct diagonalization. We show that this mechanism generalizes to a broader family of correlation structures, with the critical hierarchy in every case set by the spectrum of an associated compact integral operator.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Wigner型随机矩阵，其中非对角元通过共享行-列随机因子产生固定强度的关联。虽然体谱矩服从纯半圆律，但关联矩阵分解为消失的体谱和可数离群特征值族，这些特征值收敛于紧致Volterra积分算子的奇异值（由布朗运动的Karhunen–Loève展开获得闭解）。每个奇异值驱动独立的BBP相变，产生等间隔离散临界点层级，并推广至更广的关联结构。
AI.motivation: 理解具有固定强度行-列相关性的Wigner型随机矩阵的谱行为，特别是离群特征值的出现机制及其相变结构。
AI.method: 利用紧致Volterra（累积和）积分算子的奇异值分解（基于布朗运动的Karhunen–Loève展开）描述关联矩阵的离群特征值；通过BBP相变理论分析耦合强度增加时的临界行为。
AI.result: 关联矩阵体谱服从半圆律；离群特征值收敛于Volterra积分算子的奇异值（前20个数值误差<1%）；每个奇异值驱动独立的BBP相变，产生等间隔离散临界点层级。
AI.conclusion: 该机制可推广至更广泛的关联结构，临界层级由紧致积分算子的谱决定。

title: Retarded interaction between opposite chiral edges in anomalous Hall crystals
summary: An anomalous Hall crystal combines spontaneous electronic crystallization with a Chern insulating gap, supporting both chiral edge modes and low-energy electronic phonons. We show that this coexistence produces a distinct dynamical effect from ordinary Chern insulators: transverse bulk phonons can mediate a retarded interaction between counterpropagating chiral edge modes on opposite sides of the sample, realizing a Luttinger-liquid variant with delayed inter-edge coupling. Using microscopic time-dependent Hartree--Fock calculations for rhombohedral pentalayer graphene, we find that lowering the carrier density softens the long-wavelength transverse phonon mode. Near this instability regime, the resulting boundary-projected phonon continuum inevitably overlaps with the edge dispersion, thereby enabling their coupling. A smoking-gun probe is a nonlocal measurement: a drive applied to one edge can induce a response on the other edge, delayed by the transverse phonon time of flight across the sample.

AI.tldr: 本文研究反常霍尔晶体中手性边缘态与横声子耦合导致的延迟边缘-边缘相互作用，在菱面体五层石墨烯中预言了可实验探测的非局域响应信号。
AI.motivation: 探究反常霍尔晶体（AHC）中自发电子结晶与陈绝缘体能隙共存时产生的新奇动力学效应，特别是边缘态与体横声子的耦合机制。
AI.method: 采用微观含时Hartree-Fock计算，针对菱面体五层石墨烯体系，分析载流子浓度对长波横声子模式的影响，并研究边缘态与声子连续谱的耦合。
AI.result: 降低载流子浓度会使长波横声子模软化；在该不稳定性附近，边界投影的声子连续谱必然与边缘色散重叠，产生耦合；驱动一边缘可在另一边缘诱导出延迟响应。
AI.conclusion: 反常霍尔晶体中存在一种区别于普通陈绝缘体的动力学效应——横声子介导的延迟边缘-边缘耦合，可通过非局域测量作为"冒烟枪"探针进行实验验证。

title: The application of theory of probability to the modelling of chemical kinetics systems
summary: We consider a model of chemical kinetics for which the derivation of equations does not rely on the law of mass action, but is rather based on such principles as the joint probability and the geometric probability. For this model a generalization is constructed for the case of reaction-diffusion systems in heterogeneous medium with respect to the convective and diffusive transfer of heat. The construction of this generalization is carried out by an alternative methodology which is based fully on a systems of ordinary differential equations, without a transition to the partial derivatives. The description of this new method is a bit similar to the finite volume method, except that it uses statistical simplifying positions and geometric probability to describe the diffusion processes. Such approach allows us to greatly simplify the numerical implementation of the resulting model, as well as to simplify the quantitative analysis of it with dynamical systems theory. Moreover, the efficiency of the parallel implementation of the numerical method is increased for the resulting model. In addition, we will consider an application of this model for the description of some example reaction with quasi-periodic regime, as well as consider an algorithm for the transition from standard models with dimensional kinetic constants to its formalism.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种不依赖质量作用定律的化学动力学模型，基于联合概率和几何概率构建。该模型推广到非均匀介质中的反应-扩散-对流-传热系统，采用常微分方程组替代偏微分方程进行建模，方法类似于有限体积法但融入了统计简化和几何概率。新方法简化了数值实现和动力系统定量分析，提高了并行计算效率，并展示了在准周期反应中的应用实例。
AI.motivation: 传统化学动力学模型依赖质量作用定律，在处理非均匀介质中的反应-扩散-对流-传热系统时存在局限性。作者希望通过联合概率和几何概率的视角，建立一种更灵活、数值实现更简单的替代性建模框架。
AI.method: 基于联合概率和几何概率构建化学动力学模型；采用常微分方程组而非偏微分方程描述反应-扩散-对流-传热系统；方法类似于有限体积法，但使用统计简化假设和几何概率描述扩散过程。
AI.result: 新方法显著简化了数值实现和动力系统理论定量分析；提高了并行数值方法的效率；能够描述具有准周期行为的反应体系。
AI.conclusion: 该替代性建模框架在简化数值实现、提升并行效率方面具有优势，并提供了从标准含维度动力学常数模型转换到该形式主义的算法，为复杂反应-扩散系统的建模提供了新途径。

title: Bragg Interferometry of Moiré Superlattices: From Geometric Phase Principles to Atomic Reconstruction
summary: The emergence of moiré superlattices formed by twisting and stacking two-dimensional materials has created a need for characterization techniques capable of mapping sub-angstrom atomic reconstruction across micron-scale fields of view. This review surveys a suite of methodologies developed to extract geometric phases in electron microscopy and X-ray spectroscopy, with a primary focus on the interference of overlapping Bragg reflections in the dark field. We provide a comparative analysis of some established techniques, including geometric phase analysis, converged beam electron diffraction holography, and various ptychographic paradigms, culminating in a discussion of Bragg interferometry for measuring interlayer displacement fields and strain in moiré materials. We demonstrate the utility of Bragg interferometry through case studies of twisted bilayer and trilayer graphene as well as transition metal dichalcogenide moiré systems. Special attention is given to the unique advantages of this dark-field interferometric method for probing buried interfaces and encapsulated heterostructures, as well as the inherent challenges of interpreting incomplete phase information in the presence of dynamical scattering. By examining the physical principles underlying these approaches, this review highlights the conceptual similarities and practical trade-offs involved in high-resolution structural mapping of materials in which the interplay between structural relaxation and electronic behavior defines a scientific frontier at the nexus of modern condensed matter physics, nanomaterials engineering, and interfacial chemistry.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了用于测量莫尔超晶格中原子级重构的电子显微镜和X射线光谱技术，重点介绍了暗场布拉格干涉测量法在测量层间位移场和应变方面的应用，并通过扭转双层/三层石墨烯及过渡金属硫族化物案例展示了其优势与挑战。
AI.motivation: 扭转和堆叠二维材料形成的莫尔超晶格涌现出新物理现象，但缺乏能够在微米级视场下高精度表征亚埃级原子重构的技术，因此需要发展相关表征方法。
AI.method: 系统综述了几何相位分析、会聚束电子衍射全息术、叠层衍射成像以及布拉格干涉测量法等技术，重点关注暗场中重叠布拉格反射的干涉原理。
AI.result: 通过扭转双层/三层石墨烯和过渡金属硫族化物莫尔系统的案例，展示了布拉格干涉测量法在测量层间位移场和应变方面的实用性，并指出其在探测埋藏界面和封装异质结构方面的独特优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文强调了不同方法之间的概念相似性和实际权衡，指出结构弛豫与电子行为之间的相互作用构成了现代凝聚态物理、纳米材料工程和界面化学的科学前沿。

title: A minimal model for the Weyl nodes and Fermi arcs of PtBi$_2$
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, see Supplementary Material as ancillary file (19 pages, 6 figures)
summary: Weyl semimetals host topologically protected Fermi arcs on their surfaces, originating from the Chern number of the bulk Weyl nodes. In trigonal PtBi$_2$, superconducting signatures have been associated with the Fermi arcs. Theoretical descriptions of this surface superconductivity have so far relied on effective models that are not directly tied to the microscopic electronic structure of the material. In this work we develop a minimal description of the low-energy bands guided by density functional theory calculations and fully constrained by the relevant crystalline and time-reversal symmetries. The model captures the evolution of the Weyl nodes with spin-orbit coupling, including node annihilations, and is able to describe the spin-momentum locking of the surface Fermi arcs. It reproduces the orbital content and the band topology of PtBi$_2$ and provides a starting point for further studies.

AI.tldr: 本文基于密度泛函理论和对称性分析，构建了PtBi₂低能带的最小模型，捕捉了Weyl节点随自旋轨道耦合的演化及表面费米弧的自旋-动量锁定，为研究其表面超导提供了微观起点。
AI.motivation: PtBi₂中已在费米弧上观测到超导迹象，但现有理论描述依赖有效模型，未与材料的微观电子结构直接关联，亟需一个基于第一性原理的、受对称性约束的微观模型。
AI.method: 基于密度泛函理论(DFT)计算，结合晶格对称性和时间反演对称性，构建了低能带的最小k·p模型，并分析Weyl节点随自旋轨道耦合的演化及表面态性质。
AI.result: 模型成功捕捉了Weyl节点的演化（包括节点湮灭）、表面费米弧的自旋-动量锁定，以及PtBi₂的轨道成分和能带拓扑。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为PtBi₂的电子结构提供了准确的微观描述，为后续研究其表面超导性质奠定了理论基础。

title: Structure-preserving variational neural fields: Uncertainty-quantified reduced-order modeling of nonlinear conservation laws
summary: Reduced-order models, such as latent dynamics models, are becoming mainstream for accelerating simulations for parameterized physical systems governed by nonlinear conservation laws. However, most existing latent dynamics frameworks suffer from two important limitations: they do not provide uncertainty estimates for model predictions, and they do not guarantee adherence to the underlying conservation laws. While these challenges have been addressed separately in prior work, a unified framework that simultaneously provides uncertainty quantification and exact conservation-law preservation remains largely unexplored. In this work, we develop a variational latent neural field framework that integrates Gaussian process-inspired surrogates, enabling estimation of predictive confidence for both in-distribution and out-of-distribution parameter regimes. Three variants of the framework are considered: IRS-UQ, PI-IRS-UQ, and ECLEIRS-UQ, corresponding to unconstrained, physics-informed, and conservation-structure-preserving formulations, respectively. Exact conservation-structure preservation is achieved by embedding the solution dynamics within a conservation-law manifold through a space-time divergence-free representation of the solution-flux field. We demonstrate the applicability of the framework through three numerical experiments: 1) 1-D advection, 2) 2-D Euler and 3) 2-D shallow water equations in parameterized settings. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach provides accurate predictions together with uncertainty estimates, while remaining robust to sparse and noisy training data. Comparisons between the proposed three approaches show that conservation-structure preserving latent representations improve robustness to degraded training data while maintaining competitive predictive accuracy and uncertainty quantification capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种变分潜在神经场框架，集成了高斯过程启发代理模型，能够在提供不确定性估计的同时确保守恒律的精确保持。通过三种变体（IRS-UQ、PI-IRS-UQ、ECLEIRS-UQ）分别实现了无约束、物理信息和守恒结构保持的潜动力学建模，并在1-D平流、2-D欧拉和2-D浅水方程实验中验证了其准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有潜动力学模型存在两个关键局限：缺乏预测不确定性估计，且无法保证遵守底层守恒律。虽然这两个问题已被分别研究过，但尚缺乏一个统一的框架来同时实现不确定性量化与守恒律保持。
AI.method: 提出变分潜在神经场框架，集成高斯过程代理以估计预测置信度。设计了三种变体：无约束（IRS-UQ）、物理信息约束（PI-IRS-UQ）和守恒结构保持（ECLEIRS-UQ）。通过时空散度为零的解-通量场表示将解动力学嵌入守恒律流形中，实现精确的守恒结构保持。
AI.result: 在1-D平流、2-D欧拉和2-D浅水方程三个数值实验中，该方法提供了准确的预测和不确定性估计，对稀疏和噪声训练数据具有鲁棒性。守恒结构保持的潜表示（ECLEIRS-UQ）在退化训练数据下提升了鲁棒性，同时保持了竞争性的预测精度和不确定性量化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功统一了不确定性量化与守恒律保持两个挑战，为参数化物理系统的高保真降阶建模提供了新途径。守恒结构保持的变体在数据质量较差时表现更优，具有实际应用价值。

title: Generalized Keldysh formalism for nonequilibrium correlation functions and its application to fluctuation dynamics
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures (Main Text) + 2 pages, 2 figures (End Matter) + 4 pages, 3 figures (Supplemental Material)
summary: Recent advances in time-resolved spectroscopies provide increasing access to collective dynamics in correlated quantum materials. However, computing the corresponding nonequilibrium two-particle correlation functions remains a major challenge. Here, by introducing a contour-dependent virtual probe field within the generalized Keldysh formalism, we propose an approach that computes such correlation functions with the vertex corrections essential for describing collective dynamics. In particular, we introduce a linear integral equation that computes the correlation functions without explicitly constructing the four-time vertex kernel, and develop its matrix-free Krylov solver based on quantics tensor trains. Combining our method with nonequilibrium dynamical mean-field theory, we show that the fluctuation dynamics of the order parameter in a nonequilibrium symmetry-broken state depends significantly on whether vertex corrections are included, and that the fluctuation and its decay time grow near the nonthermal critical point. Our approach thus provides a practical route for evaluating nonequilibrium correlation functions, which are emerging as key observables for characterizing states far from equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于广义Keldysh形式论和量子张量列的方法，用于高效计算非平衡量子材料中的两粒子关联函数，并展示了顶点修正对序参量涨落动力学的关键影响。
AI.motivation: 时间分辨光谱技术的进步提供了越来越多关联量子材料中集体动力学的信息，但计算相应的非平衡两粒子关联函数仍然是一个重大挑战。
AI.method: 在广义Keldysh形式论中引入一个依赖于轮廓的虚拟探头场，提出了一种线性积分方程来计算关联函数，无需显式构造四时顶点核，并基于量子张量列发展了无矩阵Krylov求解器。
AI.result: 与非平衡动力学平均场理论相结合，展示了非平衡对称破缺态中序参量的涨落动力学显著依赖于是否包含顶点修正，且涨落及其衰减时间在非热临界点附近增长。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为评估非平衡关联函数提供了一条实用途径，而这些关联函数正成为表征远离平衡态的关键可观测量。

title: Dimensional and Spin Interpolation for the O$(n)$ Model: From Exact Anchors to RG-Improved Critical Exponents
summary: We develop a two-axis interpolation framework for the O$(n)$ universality family, treating the spatial dimension $D$ and the spin-component number $n$ as independent continuous parameters connecting exact limiting solutions. On the spatial axis, anchoring between the Onsager solution at $D=2$ and mean-field theory at $D\to\infty$ yields a closed-form prediction for the 3D Ising critical coupling that agrees well with Monte Carlo benchmarks $K_c = 0.2204$ (benchmark: $0.22165$) with no adjustable parameters. Wilson--Fisher-constrained polynomial interpolation gives $ν=2/3$, $β=31/96$, and $η=35/864$ at $D=3$ (benchmarks: $0.6299$, $0.3265$, $0.0362$), and reproduces conformal-bootstrap results across $3 \le D < 4$. On the spin axis, we establish a necessary compatibility criterion: two-anchor interpolation succeeds only for observables that vary monotonically between the anchor values. The critical coupling $K_c(n)$ violates this criterion because the Heisenberg value falls below the spherical limit, whereas the correlation-length exponent $ν(n)$ satisfies it. A perturbative $1/n^2$ expansion yields $ν(3) = 0.7493$ (benchmark: $0.7112$), and propagation through exact scaling relations gives $β(3) = 0.3797$ (benchmark: $0.3689$) and $γ(3) = 1.489$ (benchmark: $1.396$), without introducing additional parameters. The framework naturally extends to non-integer spin, producing the prediction $ν(2.5) = 0.7143$ for the O$(2.5)$ universality class. These results establish dimensional and spin interpolation as a unified and predictive approach to critical phenomena, while clarifying the structural conditions under which interpolation succeeds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个双轴插值框架，将空间维度D和自旋分量数n作为连续参数处理，统一描述O(n)普适类。通过精确锚定已知极限解（如D=2的Onsager解、D→∞的平均场理论、n→∞的球面极限），无需可调参数即可预测3D Ising模型的临界耦合与临界指数，并拓展至非整数自旋（如O(2.5)）。同时揭示了插值成功的结构条件：可观测量必须在锚点间单调变化。
AI.motivation: 现有对O(n)普适类的研究通常分别处理维度D或自旋数n，缺乏一个统一的框架来连续连接不同极限解。作者希望建立一种双轴插值方法，将D和n视为独立连续参数，从而统一描述临界现象，并揭示插值方法成功或失败的结构条件。
AI.method: 在空间轴上，以D=2的Onsager解和D→∞的平均场理论为锚点进行插值，预测3D Ising临界耦合；再通过Wilson-Fisher约束的多项式插值得到临界指数。在自旋轴上，以n=1（Ising）和n→∞（球面模型）为锚点，建立单调性判据，并利用1/n²微扰展开预测n=3（Heisenberg）及非整数自旋的临界指数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证实了维度和自旋双轴插值可以作为统一且具有预测性的临界现象研究框架，同时澄清了插值方法成功适用的结构条件即可观测量在锚点间的单调性。框架可自然推广至非整数自旋，拓展了O(n)普适类的研究边界。

title: Lifshitz-Kosevich Theory of Anomalous Landau Levels in Topological Flat Bands
summary: In conventional metals, quantum oscillations arise from Landau quantization of Fermi-surface cyclotron orbits, whose dynamics are governed by the Fermi velocity and cyclotron effective mass within Lifshitz-Kosevich (LK) theory. A perfectly flat band, by contrast, has vanishing group velocity, which would naively imply an infinite cyclotron mass and complete thermal suppression of quantum oscillations. Yet topological flat bands can support anomalous Landau levels (LLs) whose finite-field spacing is generated by quantum geometry rather than band curvature, allowing quantum oscillations to persist. This work addresses how such anomalous flat-band LLs behave within the LK framework and whether their thermal damping can reveal quantum geometric information. Using a minimal model with exactly flat topological bands, we derive an LK theory for these anomalous LLs and analyze fixed-density magnetization oscillations. The resulting oscillations exhibit a finite LK effective mass that is substantially larger than the normal-band value and possesses a strong magnetic-field dependence. In the weak-field limit, this anomalous mass reflects the quantum geometric origin of the LL spacing and scales inversely with both the magnetic field and the trace of the quantum metric. Thus, thermal damping of flat-band quantum oscillations directly measures the quantum metric, establishing quantum oscillations as a probe to flat-band quantum geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了拓扑平带中由量子几何而非能带曲率产生的反常朗道能级，推导了适用于这些反常能级的Lifshitz-Kosevich理论，发现其热阻尼可用来直接测量量子度量张量，从而建立量子振荡作为平带量子几何探针的新方法。
AI.motivation: 传统Lifshitz-Kosevich理论认为平带（群速度为零）的回旋质量为无穷大，量子振荡会被完全热抑制。但拓扑平带中存在由量子几何而非能带弯曲产生的反常朗道能级，其有限场间距使得量子振荡可能持续。作者希望厘清这些反常能级在LK框架中的行为，并探究其热阻尼是否能揭示量子几何信息。
AI.method: 采用具有严格平带的最小拓扑带模型，推导适用于反常朗道能级的LK理论，并分析固定密度下的磁化振荡行为。
AI.result: 反常磁化振荡的LK有效质量远大于正常带值，且具有强磁场依赖性。在弱场极限下，该反常质量反映朗道能级间距的量子几何起源，与磁场强度及量子度量张量的迹成反比。
AI.conclusion: 平带量子振荡的热阻尼可直接测量量子度量张量，由此建立了量子振荡作为探测平带量子几何的有效实验手段。

title: Challenges in the simulation of enzymatic transition states with emerging multireference character
summary: Highly successful drugs, such as transition-state inhibitors, were designed by mimicking the precise geometry of enzymatic transition states, a strategy that requires quantum chemistry accurate enough to specify molecular structure at sub-Å resolution. A central challenge during such a quantum chemistry simulation is that classical single-reference method can deviate substantially from the exact energy at strongly correlated transition states. We study the breakdown due to multireference character by studying a model system with a multireference transition state. In this work we present a proprietary PexMachina solver which reproduces the exact ground-state energy throughout the transition state scan, while single-reference methods struggle for certain geometries to achieve chemical accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为PexMachina的专有求解器，能够在过渡态扫描中精确再现基态能量，而单参考方法在某些几何构型下难以达到化学精度。
AI.motivation: 设计高效药物（如过渡态抑制剂）需要亚Å级精度的量子化学模拟，但经典单参考方法在强关联过渡态处会显著偏离精确能量，因此需要解决多参考态特征导致的模拟失效问题。
AI.method: 通过研究具有多参考过渡态的模型系统，使用专有的PexMachina求解器进行模拟，并与单参考方法进行对比。
AI.result: PexMachina求解器在整个过渡态扫描中精确再现了基态能量，而单参考方法在某些几何构型下无法达到化学精度。
AI.conclusion: PexMachina求解器有效克服了多参考态带来的计算挑战，为高精度药物设计提供了更可靠的量子化学工具。

title: The Precursor Genome: A Pairwise Reaction Dataset for Solid-State Synthesis
summary: Solid-state reactions remain the dominant route to inorganic materials, yet no large, machine-readable dataset reports their experimental protocols and outcomes with consistent provenance; this gap obstructs first-principles, data-driven, and machine-learning approaches to synthesis science. Here, we present the Precursor Genome, a dataset of 1,035 pairwise solid-state reactions generated autonomously by the A-Lab self-driving laboratory, spanning 46 precursors and 39 elements. Every reaction is reported together with its full experimental metadata, including measured thermal profiles, precursor and recovered masses, and instrument configuration. Every product mixture is identified from raw X-ray diffraction (1,351 scans) through automated Rietveld refinement with the Dara framework, yielding 1,950 refinement cases that are independently validated by human experts on a three-tier quality scale. Raw pattern files, serialized refinement objects, and reviewer annotations are distributed through a Pydantic-validated JSON ledger, preserving full traceability from each precursor pair to its final phase assignment. The Precursor Genome establishes a FAIR, reusable benchmark for training and evaluating predictive models of solid-state reactivity.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Precursor Genome数据集，包含1,035个由A-Lab自主实验室生成的固相反应数据，涵盖46种前驱体和39种元素，所有反应均附有完整的实验元数据、XRD图谱及自动Rietveld精修结果，并经过人工验证，为固相反应预测模型提供了FAIR基准。
AI.motivation: 现有缺乏大规模、机器可读且具有一致来源的固相反应实验数据集，阻碍了数据驱动和机器学习方法在合成科学中的应用。
AI.method: 利用A-Lab自主实验室自动生成1,035个二元固相反应，通过自动化Rietveld精修（Dara框架）处理1,351张XRD扫描，得到1,950个精修案例，再由专家按三级质量标尺独立验证，数据以Pydantic验证的JSON格式存储。
AI.result: 构建了Precursor Genome数据集，包含完整的实验元数据（热曲线、质量、仪器配置等）、原始XRD图谱、序列化精修对象及评审注释，实现从前驱体对到最终物相的全链路可追溯。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为固相反应性预测模型的训练和评估建立了FAIR（可查找、可访问、可互操作、可复用）的基准，推动合成科学的数据驱动发展。

title: Ferroelectric--Superconducting Interaction in Epitaxial YBa2Cu3O7-δ/BaTiO3 Films
summary: Microscopic theories predict that the critical temperature of a superconducting layer can be strongly modified in proximity to a ferroelectric; however, experimental evidence is lacking. We report on BaTiO3 (BTO)/YBa2Cu3O7-δ (YBCO) heterostructures grown on SrTiO3 (001) substrates using pulsed laser deposition (PLD), with precise control of growth conditions and oxygen stoichiometry. Piezoresponse force microscopy confirms ferroelectric switching within both single-layer and heterostructured films. Neutron reflectometry measurements show low roughness parameters for the buried interfaces, which is critical for mediating the interfacial coupling between superconductivity and ferroelectric polarization. The superconducting transition temperature ($T_{\mathrm{C}}^{R}$) measured from the $R(T)$ curve of the single-layer YBCO was approximately 86 K, and a transition temperature ($T_{\mathrm{C}}^{M}$) of approximately 80-85 K was observed from the $M(T)$ curve. For the heterostructure film (YBCO/BTO/YBCO) grown under the same conditions, both resistivity and magnetization measurements indicate lower transition temperatures of approximately 75 K and approximately 55 K, respectively, as well as a lower overall susceptibility. These findings highlight the need to combine multiple techniques to characterize BTO/YBCO heterostructures and identify subtle features of the ferroelectric--superconducting coupling. This establishes BTO/YBCO heterostructures as promising systems for tunable oxide electronics and reconfigurable superconducting devices.

AI.tldr: 在BaTiO3/YBa2Cu3O7-δ异质结中观察到铁电性对超导电性的显著调制，使超导转变温度从~86K降低至~55-75K，证实了铁电-超导耦合效应。
AI.motivation: 微观理论预测超导层的临界温度在铁电体附近会发生显著变化，但缺乏实验证据。本文旨在实验验证这一铁电-超导耦合效应。
AI.method: 采用脉冲激光沉积在SrTiO3(001)衬底上生长BTO/YBCO异质结构，通过压电力显微镜确认铁电开关，利用中子反射测量表征界面粗糙度，结合电阻和磁化率测量超导转变温度。
AI.result: 单层YBCO的Tc约86K，而异质结构YBCO/BTO/YBCO的Tc降低至约75K（电阻测量）和约55K（磁化测量），同时磁化率整体降低。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了铁电-超导耦合的存在，强调了多技术联合表征的必要性，并指出BTO/YBCO异质结构可用于可调谐氧化物电子学和可重构超导器件。

title: Compact and Stable Representation of Real-Frequency Spectral Functions for Machine Learning
summary: We introduce a compact and stable moment representation for real-frequency Green's functions, hybridization functions, and self-energies for machine-learning applications, avoiding the inefficiency of dense frequency grids as well as the ill-posed analytic continuation of Matsubara approaches. The representation is constructed from Cayley-mapped trigonometric moments with the Jacobian included, which preserve spectral-weight normalization, tie the moment sequence to a positive matrix-valued spectral measure, and admit a systematic route to a pole representation via ESPRIT. This provides a fixed-dimensional learning target in which physical constraints such as normalization and positivity can be imposed directly. Using a graph-attention neural network with FiLM conditioning, we benchmark the representation on single-orbital DMFT, antiferromagnetic DMFT, and a two-orbital impurity model. The results demonstrate accuracy matching or exceeding that of direct frequency-domain learning, reliable reproduction of the density and staggered magnetization, stable self-energy reconstruction through Dyson equation inversion, and accurate recovery of matrix-valued spectra with orbital mixing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Cayley映射三角矩的紧致稳定表示方法，用于实频格林函数、杂化函数和自能的机器学习，避免了密集频率网格和Matsubara解析延拓的问题。通过图注意力神经网络在单轨道DMFT、反铁磁DMFT和双轨道杂质模型上验证，结果在精度、物理约束保持和谱恢复方面均优于传统频域方法。
AI.motivation: 现有实频格林函数等在机器学习应用中面临两大问题：一是密集频率网格效率低下，二是Matsubara方法涉及的解析延拓是不适定问题。因此需要一种紧凑、稳定且能直接施加物理约束的表示方法。
AI.method: 基于Cayley映射的三角矩表示，通过包含Jacobian项来保持谱权重归一化，将矩序列与正矩阵值谱测度联系起来，并利用ESPRIT实现极点表示。结合带FiLM条件化的图注意力神经网络进行学习。
AI.result: 在单轨道DMFT、反铁磁DMFT和双轨道杂质模型上，该方法在精度上达到或超过直接频域学习，能可靠复现密度和交错磁化强度，通过Dyson方程反演稳定重建自能，并准确恢复含轨道混合的矩阵值谱。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为量子多体问题的机器学习提供了一种固定维度的学习目标，能直接施加归一化和正定性等物理约束，在多个基准测试中表现出色，具有广泛适用性。

title: Conformal Nature of Quantum Phase Transitions via Fuzzy Three-Sphere Regularization
summary: Conformal field theory (CFT) offers a modern viewpoint for understanding phase transitions. However, directly accessing the conformal algebra and microscopically uncovering the emergent conformal symmetry, especially in higher dimensions, remains a significant challenge. Motivated by recent advances in revealing CFT features via the fuzzy two-sphere, here we generalize this approach to higher dimensions and aim to expose the conformality at the (3+1)-D quantum critical point. We demonstrate this framework by investigating quantum phase transitions belonging to the Ising and Yang-Lee universality classes in a (3+1)-D quantum model (equivalent to a classical four-dimensional system), realized via Landau level projection on the fuzzy three-sphere. By computing the energy spectra at criticality, we explicitly verify the state-operator correspondence, a hallmark of conformal invariance. Together with prior advances, this work establishes a new pathway for the microscopic study of emergent conformality in higher-dimensional phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将模糊球面方法推广到高维，在(3+1)-D量子临界点上利用模糊三维球面投影，明确验证了Ising和Yang-Lee普适类的态-算符对应关系，为研究高维相变中的涌现共形对称性提供了新途径。
AI.motivation: 直接获取共形代数并在微观上揭示涌现共形对称性（尤其是高维情况）仍是一个重大挑战，现有方法难以直接验证高维量子临界点的共形不变性。
AI.method: 将模糊二维球面方法推广到高维，利用朗道能级投影到模糊三维球面，构建(3+1)-D量子模型（等价于四维经典系统），通过计算临界点处的能谱来验证态-算符对应关系。
AI.result: 成功在临界点处计算了能谱，明确验证了态-算符对应关系——共形不变性的标志性特征。
AI.conclusion: 本研究结合先前进展，建立了一条微观研究高维相变中涌现共形性的新路径。

title: Finite-time Scaling of the surface special transition in a 3D classical Heisenberg model
summary: We investigate nonequilibrium driven dynamics across the special surface phase transition in the three-dimensional classical Heisenberg model with open boundaries, where tuning the surface coupling gives access to an extraordinary-log boundary critical state characterized by logarithmic, rather than power-law, decay of correlations. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we realize four driving protocols: temperature heating and cooling across the special transition, and surface-coupling ramps from the ordinary and extraordinary-log critical states into the special point. For temperature-driven protocols, the surface order parameter obeys a generalization of the finite-time scaling (FTS) and the Kibble-Zurek mechanism. The central finding emerges when the system is driven from the extraordinary-log critical state: the large-rate scaling relation acquires a logarithmic correction and takes the novel form $M^{2}_{s}\propto R^{(1+η_{s})/r_{s}}[\log(LR^{1/η_{s}})]^{-q}$ , where $R$ is the driving rate, $L$ the system size, $η_{s}$ the surface anomalous dimension, $r_{s}$ the scaling dimension of $R$, and $q$ the exponent governing the logarithmic boundary criticality. We demonstrate that this form follows from the general FTS framework by incorporating the logarithmic initial-state memory, and we achieve excellent data collapse over a wide range of system sizes and driving rates. Our results establish that extraordinary-log initial states alter nonequilibrium critical scaling, extending boundary FTS beyond conventional power-law initial conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究三维经典海森堡模型中的非平衡驱动动力学，发现从extraordinary-log临界态驱动时，有限时间标度关系出现对数修正，并建立了新的标度形式。
AI.motivation: 探究非平衡驱动穿过特殊表面相变时的动力学行为，特别是初始态为extraordinary-log边界临界态时有限时间标度理论的推广。
AI.method: 使用蒙特卡洛模拟，实现四种驱动协议：温度加热/冷却穿过特殊相变，以及从ordinary和extraordinary-log临界态向特殊点的表面耦合扫掠。
AI.result: 发现从extraordinary-log临界态驱动时，大速率标度关系出现对数修正，形式为 $M^{2}_{s}\propto R^{(1+η_{s})/r_{s}}[\log(LR^{1/η_{s}})]^{-q}$，并在大范围系统尺寸和速率下实现数据塌缩。
AI.conclusion: extraordinary-log初始态会改变非平衡临界标度行为，将边界有限时间标度理论推广到超越常规幂律初始条件的范畴。

title: Staggered orbital magnetization from itinerant electrons: orbital antiferro- and ferrimagnetic phases
summary: Because electronic orbital angular momentum in solids is inherently non-local, its contribution to magnetism is usually cast in terms of a net orbital magnetization. Here, we show that itinerant electrons can generate orbital magnetic phases with ferromagnetic, antiferromagnetic, or ferrimagnetic orders. We demonstrate this possibility in a honeycomb lattice, using both the standard and a modified Haldane model. Employing real-space formulations, we decompose the itinerant orbital magnetization into sublattice contributions, $M_A$ and $M_B$. Their net ($M_z=M_A+M_B$) and staggered ($M_z^s=M_A-M_B$) combinations are then used to identify the orbital order. By varying the sublattice potential and the Fermi energy, we find distinct regimes: a (PT)-symmetric orbital antiferromagnet in the modified Haldane model, an orbital ferromagnet in the standard Haldane model, ferrimagnetic metallic states where net and staggered orbital magnetizations coexist, and insulating regimes in which the ferro- and antiferromagnetic orbital characters can be interchanged.These findings are explained by a low-energy theory in terms of two distinct valley mechanisms: valley-dependent Dirac masses in the standard Haldane model and valley-dependent energy shifts in its modified version.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了固体中巡游电子轨道角动量产生的磁性相，包括铁磁、反铁磁和亚铁磁序，通过Haldane模型及其改进版本在蜂窝晶格中实现，并利用实空间公式分解为子格贡献来识别轨道序。
AI.motivation: 由于电子轨道角动量在固体中本质上是非局域的，其磁性贡献通常被归结为净轨道磁化强度，但轨道磁有序的可能性尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 采用标准Haldane模型和改进版Haldane模型，在蜂窝晶格中利用实空间公式将轨道磁化分解为两个子格贡献MA和MB，通过净组合Mz=MA+MB和交错组合Mz^s=MA-MB来识别轨道序，并结合低能理论从谷机制解释结果。
AI.result: 发现了不同的轨道磁性相：改进Haldane模型中的PT对称轨道反铁磁体、标准Haldane模型中的轨道铁磁体、净和交错轨道磁化共存的亚铁磁金属态，以及铁磁与反铁磁轨道特性可互换的绝缘态。
AI.conclusion: 两种不同的谷机制可解释这些发现：标准Haldane模型中的谷依赖狄拉克质量，以及改进模型中的谷依赖能量偏移。

title: Inverse-IMPRESSION: A Graph-based Platform for Molecular Structure Elucidation from Experimental NMR Spectroscopic Properties
comment: 15-page manuscript (4 figures), plus 59 pages of Supporting Information (45 figures); Submitted to the Journal of the American Chemical Society
summary: Here, we present a platform built on our inverted Graph Transformer Network, IMPRESSION-G2, which can accurately and rapidly reconstruct molecular bonding directly from experimental nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopic information. It comprises three interconnected stages: a one-shot model that predicts bond connectivity between atoms; a structure-correction stage that corrects the predicted structures by removing uncertain bonds and iteratively reassigning them; noise-augmented multi-shot prediction, generating an ensemble of candidate structures, which are ranked to identify the best-fit structure. By integrating a range of $^{1}$H and $^{13}$C NMR data, including two-dimensional (2D) experiments such as COSY, HSQC, and HMBC, the inverse-IMPRESSION platform correctly identifies the structures of 77.8% of molecules with up to 30 heavy atoms (H, C, N, O and F) using simulated NMR data, and 10 of 19 (53%) molecules using experimental NMR data. The experimental structures solved have molecular weights of up to 480 Da and are representative of the complex structures in synthetic and natural products that routinely challenge chemists. The inverse-IMPRESSION framework thus provides the first effective approach for automated molecular structure elucidation using graph-based machine learning on experimental data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于反向图变换网络IMPRESSION-G2的平台，能从实验NMR数据中快速准确地重建分子键连接，在模拟数据上对30个重原子以内分子的识别正确率达77.8%，实验数据上19个分子中正确识别10个（53%），是首个基于图机器学习的自动化分子结构解析方法。
AI.motivation: 传统从NMR谱图解析分子结构依赖化学家的专业经验，耗时且主观。当前缺乏有效的自动化方法，特别是基于图机器学习的端到端方法，能够直接从实验NMR数据重建分子结构。
AI.method: 提出inverse-IMPRESSION平台，包含三个阶段：(1) one-shot模型预测原子间键连接；(2) 结构校正阶段，移除不确定键并迭代重分配；(3) 噪声增强的多轮预测，生成候选结构集合并排序。利用$^1$H和$^{13}$C NMR数据（包括COSY、HSQC、HMBC等2D实验）。
AI.result: 模拟NMR数据上，对最多30个重原子（H, C, N, O, F）的分子正确识别率77.8%；实验NMR数据上，19个分子中成功解析10个（53%），解析的分子量最高达480 Da，涵盖合成和天然产物中的复杂结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架首次实现了基于图机器学习的实验数据自动化分子结构解析，能够应对传统上困扰化学家的复杂分子结构，具有重要的实用价值。

title: Auditing Machine-Learning Models and Their Training Data with Explainability and First-Principles Verification: Application to Spin Hall Conductivity
summary: Machine-learning models for materials properties rest on two assumptions that standard validation never tests: that a model's features reflect the physics of the property rather than accidents of the training distribution, and that the training labels are themselves correct. We introduce a model-agnostic audit protocol for both, combining SHAP attribution, counterfactual partial dependence analysis, and Rashomon-style cross-model verification, with every finding adjudicated by targeted density functional theory (DFT). Demonstrated on intrinsic spin Hall conductivity using a composition-only Random Forest, the model needs no relaxed crystal structure, reaching accuracy competitive with structure-aware graph networks while remaining applicable to the far larger space of compositions for which no structure has been computed. The model audit reveals that the average p-valence descriptor becomes statistically entangled with Pt content - a property of the learned representation rather than the physics; DFT confirms the consequence, a Pt-free compound (HgOsPb$_2$) whose true SHC is nearly four times the prediction. The data audit exposes a thirtyfold error in the HfC training label, inherited undetectably by every black-box model trained on the same data. The protocol audits a model and its training data for the cost of a few DFT calculations, wherever one element dominates the high-property regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种与模型无关的审计协议，结合SHAP归因、反事实偏依赖分析和Rashomon式跨模型验证，并通过DFT计算验证，用于检测材料机器学习模型中的特征误导和标签错误。
AI.motivation: 标准模型验证无法检测两个潜在问题：模型特征反映的是训练分布中的偶然性而非物理机制，以及训练标签自身可能存在错误。现有方法也无法同时审计这两个方面。
AI.method: 提出审计协议：(1) SHAP归因分析特征重要性；(2) 反事实偏依赖分析检验特征与物理性质的因果关系；(3) Rashomon式跨模型验证不同模型的共识性；(4) 所有发现由DFT计算最终裁决。
AI.result: 在自旋霍尔电导率任务上，仅用成分的随机森林模型达到了与结构感知图网络相当的精度。审计发现p-价电子描述符与Pt含量统计纠缠（伪相关），DFT证实无Pt化合物HgOsPb₂的SHC接近预测值的4倍；数据审计暴露出HfC训练标签存在30倍误差。
AI.conclusion: 该协议以少量DFT计算为代价，即可有效审计模型和训练数据，适用于高属性值区域由单一元素主导的场景。

title: Strain-Tuned Nodal Superconductivity in the Charge-Ordered Kagome Metal CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures, to appear in Phys. Rev. Lett
summary: The nature of the superconducting pairing symmetry in the kagome metal CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ and its relationship with the charge density wave (CDW) order are central unresolved issues. Here, we investigate the evolution of superconductivity in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ under in-situ uniaxial pressure using $^{121}$Sb nuclear quadrupole resonance (NQR). We find that tensile strain significantly enhances the superconducting transition temperature, $T_{\rm c}$, while the CDW remains unchanged, demonstrating that superconductivity can be tuned independently of the bulk charge order. At a tensile strain of $\varepsilon$ = +0.90%, the nuclear spin-lattice relaxation rate reveals a remarkable double transition: an upper transition at $T_{\rm c1}$ = 3.6 K to a nodal gap state, and a lower one at $T_{\rm c2}$ = 3.0 K characterized by a nodeless gap. These results evidence degenerate superconducting states with different gap symmetry in the kagome metal at ambient pressure which split under strain. Our work demonstrates a high tunability of superconductivity by uniaxial pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文通过核四极共振技术研究CsV₃Sb₅在单轴压力下的超导性质，发现拉伸应变可独立于电荷密度波调控超导转变温度，并在0.90%应变下观测到从有节点到无节点能隙的两次超导转变，揭示了该材料中简并的超导配对态。
AI.motivation: Kagome金属CsV₃Sb₅的超导配对对称性及其与电荷密度波的关系是当前未解决的核心问题。
AI.method: 利用¹²¹Sb核四极共振技术，对CsV₃Sb₅在原位单轴压力下超导性质的演变进行测量。
AI.result: 拉伸应变显著提升超导转变温度Tc，而CDW保持不变；在ε=+0.90%应变下，核自旋-晶格弛豫率显示两次转变：上转变Tc1=3.6K对应有节点能隙态，下转变Tc2=3.0K对应无节点能隙态。
AI.conclusion: Kagome金属在常压下存在不同能隙对称性的简并超导态，在应变下发生分裂；超导性可通过单轴压力高度调控。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Structure-Property Mapping of Spinodoid Metamaterials via Heteroscedastic Gaussian Process Regression
summary: Spinodoid metamaterials offer a broad, tunable design space for anisotropic mechanical properties, yet their structure-property relationships are commonly treated as representative mappings from cone-angle descriptors to single effective stiffness values. This deterministic view overlooks the stochastic nature of Gaussian random field (GRF)-based topology generation, where identical cone-angle descriptors can produce different morphology realizations and property scatter. Here, we present an uncertainty-aware structure-property mapping framework that reinterprets cone-angle descriptors as stochastic descriptors associated with input-dependent property distributions. Using heteroscedastic Gaussian process regression (GPR), the framework infers input-dependent predictive uncertainty from sparse one-realization-per-point data without requiring empirical variance labels at every design point. The results show that stiffness scatter differs across tensor components according to each component's mechanically active directions, and that parameter sets yielding identical mean stiffness can carry different aleatoric uncertainty. Applying this uncertainty to reliability-based design optimization (RBDO), we show that a deterministic optimum is highly susceptible to constraint violation once morphology-induced variability is considered, and that a homoscedastic RBDO formulation fails to meet the prescribed reliability target - only the heteroscedastic formulation satisfies the reliability target under the heteroscedastic uncertainty evaluation. This establishes uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling as essential for reliability-aware inverse design of spinodoid metamaterials; extending the framework to nonlinear responses remains for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑不确定性的自旋体超材料结构-性能映射框架，采用异方差高斯过程回归从稀疏数据中推断输入相关的刚度分布，并证明其在可靠性优化设计中优于确定性及同方差方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自旋体超材料的结构-性能映射通常将锥角描述符视为确定性输入，忽略了高斯随机场生成拓扑时产生的随机形态变化和性能离散性。
AI.method: 采用异方差高斯过程回归（GPR），从每个设计点仅有一个实现数据的稀疏条件中推断输入相关的预测不确定性，将锥角描述符重新解释为随机描述符。
AI.result: 刚度离散程度在不同张量分量上不同，与各分量的力学活跃方向相关；参数集可能产生相同的平均刚度但承载不同的偶然不确定性；确定性最优解在考虑形态变异后极易违反约束；同方差RBDO无法满足可靠性目标，而异方差RBDO可以。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知的代理建模对于自旋体超材料的可靠性逆向设计至关重要，未来需扩展到非线性响应分析。

title: Fractionalized metals from doped anyons: Application to tMoTe2
summary: A fluid of mobile anyons may arise naturally when a Fractional Quantum Anomalous Hall (FQAH) state is doped. Motivated by recent experiments on twisted $MoTe_2$, we study metallic phases obtained by doping the $σ_{xy} = 2e^2/3h$ state. We propose that the high-resistivity metal observed adjacent to this FQAH state is a $Z_3$ Orthogonal Metal: a non-Fermi liquid with sharp charge $1/3$ fermionic quasiparticles coupled to a discrete $Z_3$ gauge field but with no sharp electronic quasiparticle. For a dilute gas of three species of charge-$1/3$ anyons with $π/3$ statistics, we construct two $U(3)$ symmetric $Z_3$ Orthogonal Metals, distinguished by whether the gapless fermions transform as $SU(3)$ triplets or singlets. We show that these states naturally yield large electrical resistivities even when the fractionalized quasiparticles are in a good metallic regime. Pairing of the charge-$1/3$ fermions produces an ordinary charge-$2e$ superconductor, smoothly connected to a BCS state but obtained through an intrinsically fractionalized normal state. We discuss experimental signatures of the idea that the normal metallic state in the lightly doped $2/3$ state may have fractionalized charge carriers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在分数阶量子反常霍尔（FQAH）态掺杂时可能自然出现的任意子流体。针对扭曲MoTe₂实验，提出掺杂σ_xy=2e²/3h态邻近的高电阻率金属是一种Z₃正交金属——一种非费米液体，具有电荷1/3的费米子准粒子和Z₃规范场，但无尖锐电子准粒子。
AI.motivation: 受扭曲MoTe₂实验启发，解释在掺杂2/3 FQAH态时观察到的高电阻率金属态的本质，探索其中可能存在的分数化载流子物理。
AI.method: 理论构建：针对具有π/3统计学的三种电荷1/3任意子稀薄气体，构造了两种U(3)对称的Z₃正交金属态，区别在于无质量费米子变换为SU(3)三重态还是单重态。
AI.result: 这些态即使在分数化准粒子处于良好金属态时也能自然产生大的电阻率；电荷1/3费米子配对可产生普通电荷2e超导体，通过分数化正常态平滑连接到BCS态。
AI.conclusion: 轻掺杂2/3态的正常金属态可能具有分数化载流子，为实验提供了可检验的物理图像。

title: Harnessing finite-size effects to gauge aging in the $2D$ Ising model
comment: 18 pages, 16 figures; to be published in the Journal of Statistical Mechanics: Theory and Experiment (JSTAT)
summary: The relaxation behavior towards equilibrium of the $2D$ Ising model with nearest-neighbor interactions has been studied with focus on the two-time autocorrelator $C(t,s)$. Finite-size effects affecting the growing magnetic domains lead to the saturation of $C(t,s)$ with a distinct plateau of height $C_{\infty}^{(2)}(s,L)$ scaling algebraically with waiting time $s$ and lattice size $L$. These scaling relations are used to produce precise estimates for the autocorrelation exponent $λ$ and dynamical exponent $z$ with deliberately small lattices. Treating smooth domain walls in a similar manner to the lattice boundaries, their effect on $C(t,s)$ can be understood as premature finite-size phenomenon, extending our ansatz to systems not yet in equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文研究二维Ising模型在最近邻相互作用下趋近平衡的弛豫行为，重点分析双时间自相关函数C(t,s)。发现有限尺寸效应导致C(t,s)出现平台饱和现象，其高度C∞^(2)(s,L)与等待时间s和晶格尺寸L呈标度关系。利用这些标度关系，可在小晶格上精确估计自相关指数λ和动力学指数z。将光滑畴壁视为类似晶格边界的有限尺寸效应，可将该理论推广到未达到平衡的系统。
AI.motivation: 研究二维Ising模型的弛豫行为，特别是通过双时间自相关函数C(t,s)理解有限尺寸效应对磁畴生长的影响，并利用这些效应在小晶格上精确估计关键动力学指数。
AI.method: 通过分析双时间自相关函数C(t,s)的饱和行为，研究其平台高度C∞^(2)(s,L)与等待时间s和晶格尺寸L的标度关系。将光滑畴壁视为类似晶格边界的有限尺寸效应，扩展理论适用范围。
AI.result: 发现了C(t,s)的平台饱和现象，其高度与s和L呈标度关系；利用这些关系在小晶格上精确估计了自相关指数λ和动力学指数z。
AI.conclusion: 有限尺寸效应可被利用来在小晶格上精确估计关键指数；光滑畴壁可视为类似边界的有限尺寸现象，从而将方法推广到非平衡系统。

title: Nonperturbative magnetotransport from band geometry in Weyl semimetals
comment: Accepted for publication in Journal of Physics: Condensed Matter
summary: We develop a nonperturbative semiclassical theory of magnetotransport in Weyl semimetals, retaining the full magnetic-field dependence of the Fermi-surface conductivity in the presence of Berry curvature and orbital magnetic moment effects. We obtain closed-form expressions valid to all orders in the magnetic field within the semiclassical regime. We show that the exact continuum formulation exhibits an intrinsic infrared sensitivity associated with the singular behavior of the orbital magnetic moment, requiring a physically motivated regularization. While the full conductivity tensor reduces to the standard quadratic magnetoconductivity, we demonstrate that magnetic-field expansion and momentum integration do not commute, leading to nonanalytic contributions at the level of scalar transport coefficients.
