Phys. 2002, 116, 4142), reaction rate coefficients in the temperature range of $75-800$ K have been computed for the H$_2$ + D $\rightarrow$ HD + H reaction. The paper puts particular emphasis on the exact treatment of overall molecular rotation and on nuclear spin symmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的、完全量子力学的热反应速率系数计算方法，通过重新排列内部坐标下振动-转动哈密顿量的动能部分，并结合高精度势能面，计算了H₂ + D → HD + H反应在75-800 K温度范围内的速率系数，特别关注了分子整体旋转和核自旋对称性的精确处理。
AI.motivation: 现有的热反应速率系数计算方法在效率或量子力学精确性上存在不足，需要一种既高效又完全量子力学的方法来处理涉及分子旋转和核自旋对称性的反应。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的部分重排形式的数值构造精确动能项，使用内部坐标下的振动-转动哈密顿量，结合Mielke等人开发的高精度全维势能面，对H₂ + D反应进行完全量子力学计算。
AI.result: 成功计算了H₂ + D → HD + H反应在75-800 K温度范围内的热反应速率系数。
AI.conclusion: 该新方法能够高效、精确地计算热反应速率系数，特别适用于需要精确处理分子整体旋转和核自旋对称性的反应体系。

title: Polarization Rotation Drives a Spin-Topological Transition in Ferroelectric Bismuth Monolayer
summary: Bismuth monolayer is the first two-dimensional elemental ferroelectric and an appealing platform for coupling polar order to spin-orbit-driven topology. However, its microscopic switching mechanism remains elusive. Here, using first-principles lattice dynamics and symmetry-adapted mode analysis, we identify a previously overlooked rotational pathway for in-plane polarization switching. Its energy barrier is more than four times lower than that of direct reversal, naturally explaining the vortexlike domain textures observed in molecular dynamics simulations. Remarkably, this polarization rotation also drives a spin-topological transition, changing the spin Chern number from $C_s=-2$ to $0$. Directional uniaxial strain further steers the polarization orientation and tunes the associated topological transition. These results establish polarization rotation as the switching mechanism of ferroelectric Bi monolayer and as an efficient route to electrically and mechanically programmable topology in two-dimensional ferroelectrics.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算发现，单层铋（Bi）的铁电翻转机制是面内极化旋转，其能垒比直接翻转低四倍以上，并且该旋转还会驱动自旋拓扑转变（自旋陈数从-2变为0），可通过单轴应变调控。
AI.motivation: 单层铋是首个二维元素铁电体，具有耦合极性序与自旋轨道拓扑的潜力，但其微观翻转机制一直不清楚，现有研究遗漏了关键路径。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理晶格动力学和对称性适配模式分析，研究极化翻转路径及对应的拓扑变化。
AI.result: 发现一种之前被忽视的极化旋转路径，能垒仅为直接翻转的1/4，解释了分子动力学模拟中的涡旋畴结构；极化旋转同时驱动自旋陈数从-2变为0，单轴应变可调控极化取向和拓扑转变。
AI.conclusion: 极化旋转是单层Bi铁电体的实际翻转机制，为二维铁电体中电学和机械可编程拓扑提供了高效途径。

title: Mode-locking instability and multiple soliton formation in GaN polariton waveguide cavities
summary: We study the emergence of multi-soliton regimes in 1D ridge polariton waveguides of two different lengths. We show that by varying the position of the gain, which in out-of-equilibrium polariton systems is provided by the pumping laser and its associated excitonic reservoir, it is possible to tune the regime of soliton formation between single and multiple solitons. This soliton dynamics can be quantitatively reproduced by solving the Gross-Pitaevskii equations of the coupled exciton-photon system, which show that the soliton splitting mechanism is governed by the exciton reservoir dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1D脊形极化激元波导中多孤子态的出现，发现通过调节泵浦激光（增益）位置，可以在单孤子和多孤子之间切换，该动力学由激子库动力学主导并可通过Gross-Pitaevskii方程定量再现。
AI.motivation: 探索非平衡极化激元系统中，通过调节增益（泵浦激光）位置来控制孤子形成模式的机制，实现对单孤子与多孤子之间的可调谐切换。
AI.method: 使用Gross-Pitaevskii方程对耦合的激子-光子系统进行数值模拟，通过改变两种不同长度1D脊形波导中泵浦激光的位置来研究孤子动力学。
AI.result: 发现增益位置的变化可以有效调控孤子形成模式，且孤子分裂机制由激子库动力学主导。
AI.conclusion: 极化激元波导中可通过控制泵浦位置实现孤子态的可调谐控制，为相关器件设计提供理论依据。

title: Correlation-consistent Gaussian basis sets for copper solids from material-constrained atomic optimization
summary: Correlation-consistent Gaussian basis sets are central to systematic molecular quantum chemistry, but their direct use in periodic solids is often limited by severe linear dependence from diffuse atomically optimized primitives. This problem is particularly acute for metallic and metal-containing systems, where reliable complete-basis-set (CBS) extrapolation is needed for correlated-wavefunction benchmarks. We introduce material-constrained atomic optimization (MCAO), a basis-set optimization framework that preserves the atomic and correlation-consistent character of Gaussian basis sets while penalizing large overlap-matrix condition numbers in representative solids. As a proof of concept, we generate Dunning-style MCAO-cc-pVXZ basis sets (X = D, T, Q) for Cu with all-electron, scalar-relativistic all-electron, effective core potential (ECP), and pseudopotential treatments. The resulting basis sets remain numerically stable for Cu solids and surfaces while reproducing molecular Cu dimer energetics and plane-wave reference properties of bulk Cu. CBS-extrapolated random-phase approximation calculations further enable a controlled assessment of pseudopotential, relativistic, and basis-set errors in bulk Cu and CO adsorption on Cu(111), providing scalar-relativistic all-electron Gaussian-basis benchmarks for the CO adsorption puzzle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出材料约束原子优化（MCAO）方法，生成适用于周期性固体的Dunning风格相关一致基组（MCAO-cc-pVXZ），解决了传统高斯基组在固体中因弥散函数导致的线性依赖问题，并在Cu体系上验证了其数值稳定性与计算精度。
AI.motivation: 传统相关一致高斯基组在周期性固体计算中因原子优化弥散函数导致严重线性依赖，尤其含金属体系限制了可靠完整基组外推和相关波函数基准计算的发展。
AI.method: 提出MCAO框架：在保持基组原子和相关一致特性的同时，对代表性固体中的重叠矩阵条件数施加惩罚；生成Cu的MCAO-cc-pVXZ（X=D,T,Q）基组，涵盖全电子、标量相对论全电子、有效核势及赝势四种处理方式。
AI.result: 新基组在Cu固体和表面计算中保持数值稳定，能复现分子Cu二聚体能量及体相Cu的平面波参考性质。基于CBS外推的随机相位近似计算实现了对体相Cu及CO在Cu(111)表面吸附中赝势、相对论和基组误差的可控评估。
AI.conclusion: MCAO方法为周期性固体的相关一致基组优化提供了有效方案，并为CO吸附难题提供了标量相对论全电子高斯基组基准。

title: Dynamical Nonrelativistic Spin Splitting via THz Nonlinear Phononics
summary: Nonrelativistic spin splitting (NRSS) in collinear antiferromagnets offers a route to high-frequency spintronics immune to stray fields, but its dynamic control has remained elusive. We demonstrate, using density functional theory (DFT) and nonlinear phononics, that THz laser pulses can achieve ultrafast, reversible control of NRSS on picosecond timescales in antiferromagnets. We derive two symmetry criteria, accounting for phonon and magnetic wavevector compatibility and order-parameter parity, to identify which Raman-active phonon modes can activate or amplify NRSS. Applying these rules to NiO and LaFeO$_3$, we show that resonant driving of an infrared-active mode at 11.08 THz transiently converts spin-degenerate NiO into an NRSS state via biquadratic anharmonic coupling, generating a time-averaged spin splitting of $\sim$40 meV. In LaFeO$_3$, selective excitation amplifies the existing NRSS by about 100%. In both cases, the induced spin splitting is accompanied by a transient SOC-induced net moment detectable via the magneto-optical Kerr effect. This framework establishes nonlinear phononics as a general route for ultrafast manipulation of spin-split antiferromagnetic phases well beyond the reach of static strain.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT和非线性声子学，提出利用太赫兹激光脉冲在反铁磁体中实现非相对论性自旋分裂的超快可逆控制，建立了普适的理论框架，并在NiO和LaFeO₃中验证了效果。
AI.motivation: 反铁磁体中的非相对论性自旋分裂为高频且无杂散磁场的自旋电子学提供了可能，但如何实现其动态控制一直未能解决。
AI.method: 基于密度泛函理论(DFT)和非线性声子学，推导了两个对称性判据（声子和磁波矢兼容性、序参量宇称），用于识别可激活或放大NRSS的拉曼活性声子模式；并在NiO和LaFeO₃中进行验证。
AI.result: 在NiO中，通过11.08 THz的红外活性模式共振驱动，经双二次非谐耦合瞬态将自旋简并的NiO转化为NRSS态，产生约40 meV的时间平均自旋分裂；在LaFeO₃中，选择性激发将现有NRSS放大约100%。两种情况下均伴随可被磁光克尔效应探测的瞬态净磁矩。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将非线性声子学确立为超快操控自旋分裂反铁磁相态的通用途径，远远超越静态应变的调控能力。

title: Extended Landau--Lifshitz equation for nanomagnets: a path-integral derivation of surface-induced magnetization nutation
summary:
An effective dynamical equation for the magnetization of a nanomagnet with surface anisotropy is derived from an atomistic spin Hamiltonian using the spin coherent-state path integral formalism. The derivation proceeds in two steps. First, the continuum Euclidean action for the many-spin nanomagnet is obtained, including the Wess--Zumino--Witten (Berry phase) term, as well as exchange, Zeeman, and core/surface anisotropy contributions. Second, the local magnetization density is decomposed into a slowly varying macrospin component and transverse spin-misalignment fluctuations driven by surface effects.
  A systematic expansion of the action is then performed up to quadratic order in the transverse-fluctuation variables. Under the adiabatic approximation, in which transverse modes relax much faster than the macrospin, these modes are eliminated by using their static Green's function solution. This results in a closed, extended Landau--Lifshitz equation for the macrospin, featuring an effective field with nontrivial corrections from spin misalignment. These corrections renormalize both the Zeeman and anisotropy fields and introduce additional terms that act as nutation- and damping-like contributions. ...
  Together, these results establish a microscopic foundation for surface-induced magnetization nutation in nanomagnets and provide a framework to estimate corrections to the precession frequency and effective damping. The corresponding shift in the ferromagnetic-resonance frequency and linewidth is measurable with standard GHz spectrometers, and the underlying adiabatic-elimination mechanism is expected to generalize to any slow magnetic variable coupled to a bath of fast-fluctuating modes.

AI.tldr: 本文从原子尺度自旋哈密顿量出发，利用自旋相干态路径积分形式，推导出含表面各向异性的纳米磁体磁化强度的有效动力学方程。通过将局域磁化密度分解为缓慢变化的宏自旋分量和表面驱动的横向自旋错向涨落，并在绝热近似下消除快速弛豫的横向模式，得到了修正的Landau-Lifshitz方程，其中有效场包含了来自自旋错向的塞曼场、各向异性场的重整化以及类似于章动和阻尼的额外项。该结果为纳米磁体中表面诱导的磁化章动提供了微观基础，并为估算进动频率和有效阻尼的修正提供了理论框架。
AI.motivation: 为含表面各向异性的纳米磁体建立从微观原子模型到宏观磁化动力学的严格推导框架，揭示表面效应对磁化动力学（特别是章动效应）的影响机制，并为实验可观测的铁磁共振频移和线宽变化提供理论预测。
AI.method: 采用自旋相干态路径积分形式，首先推导包含Wess-Zumino-Witten（Berry相位）项、交换、塞曼以及核/表面各向异性贡献的多自旋纳米磁体的连续欧几里得作用量；然后将局域磁化密度分解为慢变宏自旋分量和表面驱动的横向涨落，对作用量进行至横向涨落变量二次项的系统展开；最后在绝热近似下利用静态格林函数消除快速弛豫的横向模式，得到闭合的扩展Landau-Lifshitz方程。
AI.result: 得到了修正的宏自旋Landau-Lifshitz方程，其有效场包含自旋错向引起的非平凡修正：塞曼场和各向异性场被重整化，并引入了类似于章动和阻尼的额外贡献。这些结果为表面诱导的纳米磁体磁化章动提供了微观基础，并可估算进动频率和有效阻尼的修正。
AI.conclusion: 所得到的铁磁共振频率和线宽的偏移可通过标准GHz谱仪测量；所采用的绝热消除机制具有普适性，可推广至任何与快速涨落模式浴耦合的慢磁变量系统。

title: Robust nuclear hyperpolarization of small molecules through intermolecular transfer of parahydrogen-derived polarization
summary: The recent advent of hyperpolarization techniques, which can enhance NMR signals by several orders of magnitude relative to thermally polarized samples, has enabled applications traditionally out of reach due to the inherently low sensitivity of NMR techniques. However, a high barrier to entry remains, as most hyperpolarization approaches either require complex instrumentation or are applicable only to a relatively small set of molecules. Here we introduce PHIPNOE, a platform that directly addresses both limitations. PHIPNOE is based on parahydrogen-induced polarization (PHIP), which is well-established as a scalable route to hyperpolarization requiring minimal instrumentation, but has been mostly restricted to molecules that undergo specific chemical reactions. We overcome this barrier by tailoring PHIP to create highly polarized, highly concentrated solutions of one specific molecule, which acts as an intermediate source of polarization. This 'source molecule' then distributes polarization to a broad range of target molecules mixed into the solution, via the spin polarization-induced nuclear Overhauser effect (SPINOE). We investigate chemical influences on PHIPNOE, and develop a predictive model to estimate enhancement based on molecular mass and T1 relaxation times. A complete run from PHIP hyperpolarization to PHIPNOE polarization transfer and signal detection takes less than one minute, the approach does not require any modifications to the NMR spectrometer, and enhancements are repeatable across molecular classes. PHIPNOE thus enables applications including single-shot multidimensional NMR, real-time monitoring of dynamic processes, and, with 300-fold signal amplification demonstrated on a benchtop spectrometer, practical low-field NMR, where we show enhanced sensitivity in detecting per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

AI.tldr: 本文介绍PHIPNOE平台，利用对氢诱导极化(PHIP)结合核Overhauser效应(SPINOE)，实现无需复杂仪器的广泛分子超极化，在低场NMR中展示300倍信号增强并成功检测PFAS污染物。
AI.motivation: 现有超极化技术要么需要复杂仪器，要么仅适用于少数分子，存在高准入门槛。作者希望开发一种既简便又通用的超极化方法。
AI.method: 基于PHIP技术先对一种"源分子"进行高极化，再通过SPINOE效应将极化转移至溶液中混合的目标分子；整个过程不到一分钟，无需改造NMR谱仪。
AI.result: 在台式谱仪上实现300倍信号放大；成功应用于单次多维NMR、实时动态过程监测以及PFAS的增强检测。
AI.conclusion: PHIPNOE有效降低了超极化技术的门槛，兼具可扩展性和普适性，为低场NMR和实时监测等应用提供了实用方案。

title: Correlated Plasmonic Excitation in Twisted Nematic Plasmonic Superlattices
summary: Superlattices with twisted configurations, such as moire lattices, have recently been extensively exploited for their unique electronic, magnetic, and optical properties. One remarkable feature of nanoscale twisted superlattices is the distinct lattice symmetries and the continuous phase transitions between periodic or aperiodic phases, representing a unique opportunity to study many emerging physical phenomena. Here, we report a correlated light and matter interaction between the collective polarization effect of nematic plasmonic superstructures and the plasmonic excitation of individual constituent nanorods in reconfigurable twisted plasmonic superlattices. Using hybrid Fe3O4 and Au nanorods as building blocks, we assembled plasmonic nematic liquid crystals with unidirectionally aligned nanorods, which could be further assembled into moire plasmonic lattices through a vertical stacking assembly method. A twist angle dependent plasmonic excitation is recognized in the twisted bilayer of two plasmonic superlattices, featuring enhanced transverse and longitudinal plasmonic excitation at a twisting angle of 0 degree and 90 degree, respectively. Such correlated plasmonic excitation in twisted plasmonic superstructures is induced by the correlation between the collective polarization effect of the liquid crystal phases and the anisotropic plasmonic excitation of individual nanorods. The magnetic orientation control allows for precise alignment of hybrid Fe3O4 and Au nanorods in polymer substrates and enables the coding of nematic domains and plasmonic patterns in each sublattice. The correlated plasmonic excitation and light polarization create reconfigurable photonic moire superlattices with well-defined domain colors, feature sizes, periodicities, symmetries, and dimensions determined by twist angles and displacements in the twisted plasmonic lattices.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了基于Fe3O4与Au纳米棒构建的可重构扭曲等离子体超晶格，其中向列型等离子体超结构的集体极化效应与单个纳米棒的等离子体激发之间存在关联的光-物质相互作用。通过垂直堆叠组装形成莫尔等离子体晶格，发现扭转角依赖的等离子体激发，在0°和90°时分别增强横向和纵向激发，这种关联激发源于液晶相的集体极化与各向异性等离子体激发的相关性，并可通过磁定向控制实现重构。
AI.motivation: 利用扭曲超晶格（如莫尔晶格）独特的晶格对称性和连续相变特性，探索纳米尺度扭曲超结构中新兴的物理现象，特别是研究等离子体超结构中的集体极化效应与单个纳米结构激发之间的关联光-物质相互作用。
AI.method: 以杂化Fe3O4和Au纳米棒为构建单元，组装成单向排列的等离子体向列型液晶，再通过垂直堆叠组装方法形成莫尔等离子体晶格；利用磁定向控制实现纳米棒在聚合物基底中的精确排列，编码向列域和等离子体图案。
AI.result: 在扭曲双层等离子体超晶格中观察到扭转角依赖的等离子体激发：0°时横向等离子体激发增强，90°时纵向激发增强。这种关联激发由液晶相的集体极化效应与各向异性等离子体激发的相关性诱导产生。磁定向控制实现了纳米棒的精确对准及可重构的光子莫尔超晶格。
AI.conclusion: 扭曲等离子体超晶格中集体极化与各向异性等离子体激发之间的相关性，为构建具有可调域色、特征尺寸、周期、对称性和维度的可重构光子莫尔超晶格提供了新途径，其特性由扭曲角和位移决定。

title: Theory of phonon-induced spin relaxation in a structured phononic reservoir
summary: By combining Markovian and non-Markovian open quantum system theory with finite-element simulations, we develop a theory of electron spin relaxation in a structured phononic reservoir. This problem is crucial for understanding spin dynamics in hybrid systems involving mechanical modes, as well as for the design of devices combining spin degrees of freedom with photonic and phononic architectures, where the phonon density of states is modulated in the relevant spectral range corresponding to moderate magnetic fields. Taking a QD in a phononic waveguide as a representative and technologically relevant example, we show that spin relaxation in such environments is much more complex than in bulk. While the relaxation rates are typically an order of magnitude higher than in bulk, there are parameter windows where the relaxation is suppressed by many orders of magnitude due to gaps in mode dispersion and selection rules imposed by mode symmetry. At the border between these two sectors, van Hove singularities in phonon dispersion lead to singularities in relaxation rates, for which we develop power-law scaling and propose a non-Markovian description of the dynamics, revealing polaronic dressing of the spin into slow acoustic modes.

AI.tldr: 本文结合马尔可夫与非马尔可夫开放量子系统理论及有限元模拟，研究了结构化声子库中电子自旋弛豫的机制，发现自旋弛豫比体材料中复杂得多，存在弛豫增强、抑制及奇异点等多种行为。
AI.motivation: 理解混合系统中自旋动力学，以及设计结合自旋自由度与光子/声子架构的器件，需要在中等磁场相关的声子态密度调制环境中研究自旋弛豫问题。
AI.method: 将马尔可夫与非马尔可夫开放量子系统理论与有限元模拟相结合，以量子点置于声子波导中作为代表性示例进行理论分析。
AI.result: 自旋弛豫率通常比体材料高一个数量级，但存在因模式色散带隙和模对称性选择定则导致的弛豫被抑制数个数量级的参数窗口；在两者边界处，范霍夫奇点导致弛豫率奇点。

title: Unconventional Spin Valve Based on Normal Metal/Chiral Molecule/Altermagnet Junctions
summary: Chiral molecules have attracted broad interdisciplinary interest for their ability to produce highly spin-polarized current. This phenomenon, known as the chiral-induced spin selectivity effect, holds great potential in the field of spintronics. Here, we propose to combine chiral molecules with altermagnets to construct highly efficient and tunable spin valves. Using the nonequilibrium Green's function method and the Landauer-Büttiker formula, we obtain the conductance and the magnetoresistance of a normal metal/chiral molecule/altermagnet spin valve. Our theoretical results reveal that the conductance of the spin valve can be effectively tuned by reorienting the Néel vector of the altermagnet, and the magnetoresistance of the spin valve increases with molecular length and altermagnetic anisotropy. Moreover, the magnetoresistance vanishes for achiral molecules or in the absence of molecular spin-orbit coupling. Our work paves the way for developing efficient, controllable, and stray-field-free spintronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将手性分子与交变磁体结合构建自旋阀，通过非平衡格林函数和Landauer-Büttiker公式计算其电导和磁阻。结果表明，通过重新取向交变磁体的Néel矢量可有效调控自旋阀电导，磁阻随分子长度和交变磁各向异性增大，且对手性和自旋-轨道耦合具有依赖性。
AI.motivation: 利用手性分子产生的自旋极化效应（手性诱导自旋选择性，CISS），结合交变磁体的无杂散场特性，构建高效且可调谐的自旋阀器件。
AI.method: 采用非平衡格林函数方法和Landauer-Büttiker公式，对正常金属/手性分子/交变磁体自旋阀进行理论建模与数值计算。
AI.result: 1) 电导可通过交变磁体Néel矢量方向有效调控；2) 磁阻随分子长度和交变磁各向异性增大；3) 非手性分子或无自旋-轨道耦合时磁阻消失。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开发高效、可控且无杂散场的自旋电子学器件提供了新途径。

title: Chiral charge density waves in transition metal dichalcogenide
summary: The emergence of chirality in the charge density wave (CDW) phase of 1$T$-TiSe$_2$ has recently attracted significant attention, yet its microscopic origin remains debated. The prevailing interpretation attributes chirality to a relative phase shift between the charge density components. Here, using density functional theory and symmetry analysis, it is demonstrated that such phase-shifted states entail prohibitive energy costs, rendering them unlikely candidates for the ground state. Instead, a nearly degenerate metastable CDW phase stacking order with monoclinic symmetry is identified, that naturally breaks mirror and inversion symmetries. The CDW in 1$T$-TiSe$_2$ possesses a dual physical nature: the electronic charge redistribution is intrinsically bond-modulated, while the periodic lattice distortion is atom-centered transverse. This spatial separation allows a specific optical coupling mechanism where circularly polarized light breaks the energetic degeneracy between chiral domains. These results reconcile conflicting experimental observations, identifying the "spontaneous" chirality observed in local probes as a statistical distribution of CDW phase stacking domains, while establishing the mechanism for macroscopic, light-induced gyrotropic order.

AI.tldr: 本文通过DFT计算和对称性分析，否定了1T-TiSe2中电荷密度波（CDW）手性源于相位位移的主流解释，指出该构型能量过高。研究发现一种近简并的亚稳态单斜CDW堆叠序可自然破缺镜面对称和反演对称，并揭示了CDW的双重物理本质：电子电荷重分布是键调制的，而晶格畸变是原子中心的横向位移。这一空间分离允许圆偏振光通过特定光耦合机制打破手性畴的简并，从而统一解释了局域探针观测到的"自发"手性与宏观光致旋光序的实验矛盾。
AI.motivation: 解决1T-TiSe2中CDW相手性起源的争议，解释相位位移解释的不足，并提出新的手性破缺机制。
AI.method: 使用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算和对称性分析，评估相位位移构型的能量可行性，识别亚稳态堆叠序，分析CDW的电子与晶格双重物理本质。
AI.result: 相位位移态能量过高，不可能是基态；发现单斜CDW堆叠序自然破缺手性对称性；CDW具有键调制电子重分布和原子中心横向畸变的双重性质；圆偏振光可通过空间分离的光耦合打破手性畴简并。
AI.conclusion: 局域探针观测到的"自发"手性实为CDW相堆叠畴的统计分布，而宏观光致旋光序可由圆偏振光诱导，统一了矛盾实验现象。

title: Purcell enhanced and blinking free single photons from InAs/GaAs quantum dots in deterministically placed circular Bragg gratings
summary:
The development of efficient, deterministic, and tunable single-photon sources is a cornerstone for the realization of long-distance quantum communication, quantum repeaters, and photonic quantum computing technologies. In this study, we demonstrate a bright, charge-tunable single-photon source in the 900 nm wavelength range based on InAs quantum dots (QDs) embedded in a p-i-n doped GaAs membrane, which shows blinking free emission.
  We use a modified circular Bragg grating (CBG) as a micro-resonator. By adding fourfold symmetric bridges in a labyrinth-like geometry, we provide a conductive pathway to the central disk, thereby enabling electrical contact to the QD while maintaining high Purcell enhancement and photon extraction efficiency (PEE). For the negative trion (X-), we demonstrate a lifetime of $44.3 \pm 0.2$ ps - corresponding to a Purcell factor of $18.0 \pm 0.7$ and a PEE of $68.1% \pm 3.1$ %. Furthermore, the device is blinking-free with very low multi-photon contribution, evidenced by a second-order autocorrelation value $g(2)(0) < 0.017 \pm 0.015$. By applying a vertical diode bias, we demonstrate precise charge-state control, resolving distinct emission plateaus ranging from the single negatively charged trion ($X^-$) to triply negatively charged excitons ($X^{3-}$).
  These results showcase a robust architecture that simultaneously provides high efficiency, high repetition rates, and deterministic charge control, fulfilling key requirements for the next generation of quantum network hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一种基于InAs量子点嵌入p-i-n掺杂GaAs膜、采用改进型环形布拉格光栅微谐振器的900nm波段电荷可调单光子源，实现了无闪烁发射、68.1%的光子提取效率、18.0的Purcell因子，以及通过电压偏压实现的精确电荷态控制（X⁻到X³⁻）。
AI.motivation: 发展高效、确定性和可调谐的单光子源是实现长距离量子通信、量子中继器和光子量子计算的关键基础。现有单光子源在效率、稳定性和电荷态控制方面仍有不足，亟需一种同时具备高亮度、高重复率和电荷可调性的集成化架构。
AI.method: 采用InAs量子点嵌入p-i-n掺杂GaAs膜，并设计了一种改进型环形布拉格光栅（添加四重对称桥接结构形成迷宫式几何），既提供导电通路实现电接触，又保持高Purcell增强和光子提取效率。通过垂直二极管偏压实现电荷态精确控制。
AI.result: 负三子（X⁻）寿命44.3±0.2 ps，Purcell因子18.0±0.7，光子提取效率68.1%±3.1%，二阶自相关g²(0)<0.017±0.015（无闪烁、低多光子贡献），电荷态从X⁻到X³⁻可分辨调节。
AI.conclusion: 该架构同时实现了高效率、高重复率和确定性电荷控制，满足下一代量子网络硬件的关键需求，为可集成单光子源提供了鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Self-Consistent Phonon Spectral Functions and Thermal Transport Beyond the Quasiparticle Approximation
summary: Anharmonic lattice dynamics shapes phonon spectra and thermal transport, yet first-principles linewidth calculations typically assume phonon quasiparticles with sharply defined frequencies. Here, we introduce a self-consistent spectral function framework that represents each phonon by its full frequency distribution and uses the resulting spectra to dress the internal lines of the three-phonon bubble self-energy. The method self-consistently determines the real and imaginary parts of the self-energy on equal footing, eliminates externally chosen smearing parameter for enforcing energy conservation, and extends lattice dynamics and thermal transport calculations beyond the quasiparticle approximation. Applied to zincblende HgTe, self-consistency substantially broadens acoustic and optical phonon spectra, activates scattering channels inaccessible in the one-shot quasiparticle calculation, and reduces the lattice thermal conductivity by approximately a factor of five to the experimental scale while reproducing its temperature dependence, without explicitly invoking higher-order interactions. Mode-resolved spectral functions are further validated against the power spectra from direct molecular dynamics simulations. These results establish self-consistent spectral functions as a practical bridge between quasiparticle perturbation theory and fully dynamical simulations, and provide a framework readily generalizable to higher-order anharmonic processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自洽谱函数框架，通过考虑声子的全频率分布而非尖锐准粒子近似，自洽地确定三声子自能的实部和虚部，消除人为展宽参数，将晶格动力学和热输运计算拓展到准粒子近似之外。应用于HgTe，自洽性显著展宽声子谱、激活新散射通道，将热导率降低约5倍至实验值，且与分子动力学功率谱吻合。
AI.motivation: 传统第一性原理线宽计算假设声子为准粒子（具有尖锐频率），但实际非谐晶格动力学中声子具有展宽频率分布，现有方法需要人为选择的展宽参数来保证能量守恒，缺乏自洽性。
AI.method: 提出自洽谱函数框架：每个声子由其完整的频率分布表示，用所得谱函数"修饰"三声子气泡自能的内线，自洽地确定自能的实部和虚部，无需外部展宽参数，将计算拓展到准粒子近似之外。
AI.result: 应用于闪锌矿HgTe：自洽性显著展宽声学及光学声子谱，激活了单次准粒子计算中无法访问的散射通道，晶格热导率降低约5倍至实验尺度，温度依赖性与实验吻合，无需显式引入高阶相互作用。模式分辨谱函数与分子动力学功率谱一致。
AI.conclusion: 自洽谱函数框架建立了准粒子微扰论与全动力学模拟之间的实用桥梁，可推广至更高阶非谐过程。

title: Robust Spin Qubit Coupler via Minimal Kitaev Chain
summary: While a minimal Kitaev chain is promised to host unprotected Majorana zero modes, its role for spin qubits is relatively underappreciated. Following recent breakthroughs in the fine control of transport behaviors, we propose to use minimal Kitaev chain as a robust coupling module between spin qubits. Long-distance, anisotropic exchange coupling can be mediated by the Andreev bound states (ABSs) in the hybrid segment. The chemical potential of ABS gives a simple way to selectively control the coupling strength and its response to local perturbations. Moreover, this additional control degree of freedom creates a unique sweet spot, allowing both strong coupling and first-order immunity against charge noise. The protected qubit encoded on the minimal Kitaev chain at the sweet spot is shown to boast over 200 fold improvement in decoherence time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用最小Kitaev链作为自旋量子比特之间的鲁棒耦合模块，通过Andreev束缚态实现长距离各向异性交换耦合，并在化学势调控下找到抗电荷噪声的“甜点”，使退相干时间提升200倍以上。
AI.motivation: 最小Kitaev链虽然已知可承载非局域Majorana零模，但其在自旋量子比特耦合中的作用未被充分认识。作者希望利用其作为中介实现自旋量子比特间的可控、长距离耦合。
AI.method: 通过混合段中的Andreev束缚态（ABS）介导自旋量子比特间的各向异性交换耦合；利用ABS化学势选择性控制耦合强度及其对局部扰动的响应；并识别出一个独特的“甜点”，在该点同时实现强耦合和一阶电荷噪声免疫。
AI.result: 在甜点处编码的量子比特退相干时间相比传统方案提升超过200倍。
AI.conclusion: 最小Kitaev链可作为自旋量子比特的高效耦合模块，通过化学势调控获得抗噪声的强耦合甜点，显著提升量子比特的相干性能。

title: Enabling temperature controlled in-situ vapor dosing for lab source X-ray reflectivity measurements
summary: X-ray Reflectivity (XRR) is a valuable technique for probing buried interfaces in complex systems relevant to thin-film, membrane, and battery applications, among others. However, many operando and in situ reflectivity cells are designed for use at synchrotron facilities, limiting the broader accessibility of these measurements. We present an XRR transmission cell that enables in situ vapor dosing and temperature-dependent experiments on in-house diffractometers. We demonstrate its capabilities with two case studies: the adsorption of water into polyamide (PA) membranes on silicon and temperature-dependent restructuring of polystyrene (PS) pseudo brushes on alumina. Vapor dosing allows for controlled release of vapor into the cell, allowing operation across a wide range of conditions from rough vacuum to saturation. We demonstrate that the manifold can reach 90-95% of saturated pressures, with the measurements presented here spanning 0-250 mbar, which is desirable for adsorption isotherms. Heating studies performed between 25 and 200C demonstrate the ability to resolve Ångstrom scale structural changes in a surface bound polymer. These results establish a novel streamlined approach to temperature controlled vapor dosing on a laboratory diffractometer, offering straightforward probe-molecule exchange, vacuum-sealed operations, and variable temperature capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种用于实验室衍射仪的X射线反射率（XRR）透射样品池，可实现原位蒸汽投加和变温实验，并通过聚酰胺膜吸水与聚苯乙烯刷热重构两个案例验证了其性能。
AI.motivation: 现有operando/in situ XRR样品池多用于同步辐射设施，限制了该技术的普适性，因此需要开发适用于常规实验室衍射仪的样品池方案。
AI.method: 设计了XRR透射样品池，支持蒸汽投加（0-250 mbar，可达饱和蒸气压的90-95%）和温度控制（25-200°C），在实验室衍射仪上实现原位测量。
AI.result: 成功演示了水在聚酰胺膜中的吸附等温线，以及聚苯乙烯刷在升温过程中Ångström级结构变化的解析能力。
AI.conclusion: 该样品池为实验室衍射仪提供了一种新型的温控蒸汽投加方案，具有探针分子更换方便、真空密封操作和变温能力等优势。

title: Discovery of a symmetry-driven electronic cascade in a $d$-wave altermagnet
summary: Altermagnets host magnetic compensation together with non-relativistic spin-split bands, a coexistence enabled by crystal symmetry. Yet whether and how crystal symmetry organizes collective electronic order remains largely unexplored. Here we uncover a symmetry-driven cascade of finite-$q$ charge order in a $d$-wave altermagnet Rb$_{1-δ}$V$_2$Te$_2$O, using phase-resolved scanning tunneling microscopy. A primary density-wave instability drives an initial electronic reconstruction, followed by the emergence of a nematic component and an off-axis modulation with wave vectors geometrically tied to the preceding orders. Phase-resolved spectroscopy distinguishes these components through separate contrast-inversion energies and maps out branch-selective spectral-weight redistribution within the off-axis mode. Together with doping and temperature evolution, these observations establish a highly coordinated hierarchy of coupled density-wave instabilities, consistent with successive symmetry lowering. This multi-component hierarchy can be well described in the Landau framework through sequential softening of the charge orders, where bilinear coupling to their compatible octupolar partners at the lower-symmetry stages enables mutual stabilization within an intertwined charge-multipole state. Such a transparent realization of a charge-order cascade shows how altermagnetic symmetry can extend beyond band formation to organize collective electronic order, offering a new perspective on emergent many-body states in correlated quantum materials.

AI.tldr: 本文利用扫描隧道显微镜在d波交变磁体Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O中发现了一个由对称性驱动的电荷序级联现象，该级联包含多个密度波不稳定性，通过Landau理论框架可以很好地解释为电荷-多极子相互耦合的协同有序态。
AI.motivation: 交变磁体兼具磁补偿和非相对论自旋分裂能带，但晶体对称性如何组织集体电子序仍不清楚，亟需探索。
AI.method: 采用相位分辨扫描隧道显微镜（STM）对d波交变磁体Rb₁₋δV₂Te₂O进行实空间观测，结合掺杂和温度演化实验，并利用Landau理论框架进行分析。
AI.result: 发现了一个多组分的密度波级联：初级密度波不稳定性驱动电子重构，随后出现向列分量和离轴调制，不同组分具有不同的对比度反转能量和分支选择性谱权重再分布。
AI.conclusion: 交变磁对称性不仅限于能带形成，还能组织集体电子序，为关联量子材料中的涌现多体态提供了新视角。

title: Capturing the calendering U-shape in lithium-ion electrode thermal conductivity
comment: Accompanying analysis and interactive visualisation available at https://j-stoerk.github.io/
summary: Calendering is a key manufacturing step in lithium-ion electrode production, increasing volumetric energy density by reducing electrode porosity. Its effect on through-plane effective thermal conductivity, however, can be non-monotonic: measurements of graphite-based anodes show an initial decrease in thermal conductivity during early calendering followed by recovery at higher compaction. Conventional porosity-based effective-medium closures cannot reproduce this U-shaped behaviour. We develop a calendering-aware extension of the Zehner--Bauer--Schlünder model that combines a Knudsen-corrected porous-medium baseline with a compression-indexed contact contribution. For graphite electrodes, the model represents the competing effects of increasing particle contact and calendering-induced reorientation of anisotropic graphite particles, which initially reduces favourable through-plane heat-transport pathways. For quasi-isotropic NMC cathodes, the observed response is instead captured through process-dependent contact-network evolution. Across 27 calendering states spanning thin and thick graphite anodes and NMC622 and NMC811 cathodes, the proposed closure reduces the mean absolute percentage error from 31.1% for the zero-fit reference model to 4.5%. The result shows that incorporating process-dependent microstructural evolution is necessary to capture the measured conductivity minimum. Validation across additional electrode formulations, thicknesses, and chemistries remains necessary to assess transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种考虑压延过程的Zeher-Bauer-Schlünder模型，通过结合Knudsen修正的多孔介质基线与压缩接触贡献，准确捕捉了锂离子电极在压延过程中有效热导率的U型变化行为，将平均绝对百分比误差从31.1%降至4.5%。
AI.motivation: 实验发现石墨负极在压延初期热导率下降、后期回升的非单调U型行为，而传统基于孔隙率的有效介质模型无法描述这一现象，亟需开发考虑加工过程影响的闭合模型。
AI.method: 在Zeher-Bauer-Schlünder模型基础上，引入Knudsen修正描述多孔介质基线热导率，并加入压缩指数相关的接触贡献项；针对石墨各向异性颗粒考虑压延引起的重新取向效应，针对NMC各向同性颗粒则通过过程依赖的接触网络演化来建模。
AI.result: 在27种压延状态（涵盖薄/厚石墨负极、NMC622和NMC811正极）上，所提模型将平均绝对百分比误差从基线模型的31.1%降至4.5%，成功捕捉了热导率最小值。
AI.conclusion: 将加工过程相关的微观结构演化纳入模型是准确描述压延过程中热导率非单调行为的必要条件，但模型在更多电极配方、厚度和化学体系上的泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Oxygen-nonstoichiometry-driven phase transition in $\mathrm{Sr}_{1-x}\mathrm{Nd}_{x}\mathrm{CoO}_{3-δ}$ ($x = 0.1, 0.2, 0.3$) perovskites
summary: We report a systematic study of the interplay between oxygen nonstoichiometry, crystal structure, and magnetic/electrotransport properties in $\mathrm{Sr}_{1-x}\mathrm{Nd}_{x}\mathrm{CoO}_{3-δ}$ ($x = 0.1, 0.2, 0.3$). High-resolution neutron powder diffraction combined with synchrotron x-ray powder diffraction reveals that increasing the oxygen content induces a structural transition from a layered $I4/mmm$ ($2a_p \times 2a_p \times 4a_p$) to an oxygen-deficient orthorhombic $Pmmm$ ($a_p \times a_p \times 2a_p$) phases with preferential oxygen-vacancy occupation. This transition is accompanied by a crossover from G-type antiferromagnetic with a weak ferromagnetic component to a ferromagnetic state, and a drastic decay in resistivity. The evolution of the magnetic and transport properties is discussed in terms of changes in the Co spin state, enhanced Co $3d$ - O $2p$ orbital overlap upon oxygen uptake, and a magnetically inhomogeneous ferromagnetic state associated with residual oxygen vacancies and mixed $\mathrm{Co}^{3+}/\mathrm{Co}^{4+}$ valence. Our findings experimentally confirm that the stabilization of the layered "314" structure is driven by the presence and ordering of oxygen vacancies rather than A-site cation ordering, whereas the oxygen-deficient oxidized compounds represent an intermediate orthorhombic state preceding fully stoichiometric phases.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Sr₁₋ₓNdₓCoO₃₋δ中氧非化学计量比与晶体结构、磁/电输运性质的关联。中子与同步辐射衍射表明，增加氧含量诱导结构从层状I4/mmm相转变为缺氧正交Pmmm相，伴随反铁磁向铁磁转变及电阻率骤降。
AI.motivation: 探究氧非化学计量比对Sr₁₋ₓNdₓCoO₃₋δ体系晶体结构与磁电性质的影响机制，厘清层状"314"结构的稳定化因素（氧空位有序 vs. A位阳离子有序）。
AI.method: 采用高分辨率中子粉末衍射结合同步辐射X射线粉末衍射进行结构解析，系统表征不同氧含量下的晶体结构、磁有序类型和电输运性质变化。

title: Anomalous Dissipation in Current Biased Josephson Systems
summary: A new phase diffusive regime in a current biased Josephson junction is theoretically explored which originates from embedding the junction in a circuit environment with anomalous dissipation. This is realized by placing parallel to the junction a resistor in series with a capacitor such that electromagnetic fluctuations effectively couple also to the charge of the junction. This leads to rich Josephson dynamics, in particular for the switching of the junction out of a zero voltage state. Modelled as the escape process of a fictitious phase-particle out of a metastable well, a detailed study reveals that anomalous dissipation has a strong impact at low temperatures when quantum tunneling dominates against thermal activation. As a manifestation, a regime is found, where for realistic circuit parameters the quantum escape process is substantially enhanced, followed by a short voltage pulse and re-trapping with high probability. This class of circuits may be leveraged for detecting microwave photons or dissipative quantum annealing processes. In addition, the analysis provides a general framework for engineering dissipative dynamics in nonlinear systems using anomalous environments.

AI.tldr: 本文理论探索了电流偏置约瑟夫森结中一种新的相位扩散机制，该机制源于将结嵌入具有反常耗散的电路环境中（并联一个电阻-电容串联支路），使得电磁涨落有效耦合到结的电荷。研究发现反常耗散在低温量子隧穿主导区域能显著增强量子逃逸过程，导致短电压脉冲和高概率重俘获现象，该电路可用于微波光子探测或耗散量子退火。
AI.motivation: 探索在电流偏置约瑟夫森结中引入反常耗散环境（通过并联RC支路）所产生的新物理效应，特别是对零电压态逃逸过程的影响。
AI.method: 将约瑟夫森结的开关过程建模为虚拟相位粒子从亚稳态势阱中的逃逸过程，在反常耗散环境下分别研究热激活和量子隧穿两种机制，并分析低温下量子隧穿的增强效应。
AI.result: 发现反常耗散在低温量子隧穿区域能显著增强量子逃逸过程，导致短电压脉冲后高概率重俘获；存在一个特定电路参数区间，使得量子逃逸大幅增强。

title: Anomalous Compressibility and Electronic Robustness of Metallic Delafossite PdCoO$_2$ under Pressure
summary: The layered delafossite PdCoO$_2$ is an exceptional oxide metal whose ultrahigh conductivity arises from a Pd-derived nearly-free-electron band. Here, high-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction combined with first-principles calculations is used to investigate its structural, bonding, and electronic evolution up to 10 GPa. PdCoO$_2$ retains the rhombohedral R-3m structure throughout the investigated pressure range, with no structural phase transition. The lattice exhibits an unusual anisotropic compression, with the in-plane a-axis contracting more strongly than the stacking c-axis, opposite to the behavior of most layered materials. Despite this anomalous compressibility, only minor changes are observed in the local Pd-O and Co-O coordination environments, indicating a remarkably rigid bonding framework. Crystal orbital Hamilton population analysis reveals only subtle strengthening of the existing bonding interactions, without the emergence of destabilizing Pd-related antibonding states. Consistent with these findings, the Pd-derived metallic band and quasi-two-dimensional Fermi surface remain essentially unchanged under compression. Boltzmann transport calculations further show that the in-plane conductivity is nearly pressure-independent, whereas the out-of-plane conductivity decreases modestly, resulting in a slight increase in transport anisotropy. These results demonstrate that the anomalous compressibility of PdCoO$_2$ originates from its robust chemical bonding network, which preserves both the crystal structure and the highly conductive Pd-derived metallic state under pressure.

AI.tldr: 通过高压X射线衍射和第一性原理计算，研究了PdCoO₂在10 GPa范围内的结构、成键和电子性质演化，发现其异常的各向异性压缩源于强健的化学键网络，且Pd衍生的高导电金属态在压力下基本保持不变。
AI.motivation: 探究层状PdCoO₂这种超高导电氧化物在高压下的结构、成键和电子性质的演化，特别是理解其异常的各向异性压缩行为与导电性能之间的关系。
AI.method: 采用高压单晶X射线衍射结合第一性原理计算，以及晶体轨道Hamilton布居分析和玻尔兹曼输运计算。
AI.result: PdCoO₂在10 GPa内保持R-3m结构，无相变。面内a轴比堆叠c轴压缩更强（异常各向异性）。Pd-O和Co-O配位环境变化极小，键合框架极为刚性。Pd衍生的金属带和准二维费米面基本不变。面内电导率几乎与压力无关，面外电导率略有下降，输运各向异性轻微增加。
AI.conclusion: PdCoO₂的异常可压缩性源于其强健的化学键网络，该网络在压力下既保持了晶体结构，也维持了高导电的Pd衍生金属态。

title: Thermodynamic bound on the Fano factor of a coherent thermoelectric heat engine
comment: 4 + 2 pages (+ supplementary info), 4 + 4 figures. Comments are welcome!
summary: We show that for fermionic coherent thermoelectric transport, selecting heat-engine operation yields a thermodynamic uncertainty relation for the charge current that imposes a universal lower limit of $F > 1/2$ on the corresponding Fano factor. We find that violations of the thermodynamic uncertainty relation for classical Markov processes, typically associated with a quantum advantage, are far more restricted for heat engines than what is allowed by a generic thermodynamic process. For bosonic and classical carriers, the minimum Fano factor increases to $F > 1$, and the thermodynamic uncertainty relation for classical Markov processes is never violated. We provide numerical evidence that all the obtained bounds are tight and can be saturated by properly designed transmissions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究费米子相干热电输运中热机运行的热力学不确定性关系，发现电荷电流的Fano因子存在普适下界（F>1/2），且玻色子和经典载流子的下界更高（F>1），表明经典马尔科夫过程热力学不确定性关系的违反在热机中比一般热力学过程更受限。
AI.motivation: 探究费米子相干热电输运中热机运行模式下的热力学不确定性关系，以及量子效应相较于经典过程是否带来优势。
AI.method: 理论分析费米子、玻色子和经典载流子的热电输运，推导电荷电流Fano因子的下界，并通过数值计算验证边界的紧致性。
