title: Why Do Thick MOCVD-Grown beta-Ga2O3 Epilayers on (001) Substrates Crack: Crystallographic Origin
summary: Thick, defect free epitaxial layers grown using industry standard techniques are a fundamental requirement for the widespread adoption of fully vertical power devices based on ultra wide bandgap gallium oxide (Ga2O3). However, metal-organic chemical vapour deposition (MOCVD) of such layers on native beta-Ga2O3 substrates with the largest diameter (001) orientation remains relatively unexplored, and the origins of the reported surface roughening and cracking with increasing thickness are not yet fully understood. To address this, we report a systematic study of MOCVD grown beta-Ga2O3 epilayers deposited at growth rates of ~3.5 um/h, with thicknesses from 0.3 to 3.5 um. The epilayers exhibit a relatively smooth but striated surface morphology, with progressively increasing nanometre-scale roughness beyond coalescence and crack formation observed from ~1.8 um thickness. High resolution X ray diffraction reveals that, despite growth on (001) substrates, the epilayers adopt a predominantly (-401)-oriented structure from the earliest stages of growth. Rocking curve analysis further indicates a higher degree of in-plane twist than tilt, both decreasing with increasing epilayer thickness. While the epilayer and substrate are lattice-matched along the [010] in plane direction, the epitaxial alignment in the orthogonal epilayer [104] in plane direction imposes, in theory, a maximum tensile in-plane strain of approximately +4.1% arising from the underlying lattice mismatch, thereby driving crack formation perpendicular to this direction. Our results suggest that this epitaxial relationship is likely associated with faceted reconstruction of the (001) substrate surface during annealing, driven by the minimisation of surface energy under oxygen-rich MOCVD growth conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了MOCVD在(001)β-Ga2O3衬底上生长厚外延层的表面粗糙化与开裂机制，发现外延层从早期就形成(-401)择优取向，沿[104]方向的最大拉伸应变约+4.1%是导致裂纹产生的根本原因，该取向关系源于氧-rich MOCVD条件下表面能最小化驱动的表面重构。
AI.motivation: 厚且无缺陷的外延层是Ga2O3垂直功率器件商业化的基础，但(001)取向大直径衬底上的MOCVD生长研究不足，且表面粗糙化与开裂的成因尚未明确，亟需系统理解。
AI.method: 在~3.5 um/h生长速率下，制备了厚度从0.3到3.5 um的β-Ga2O3外延层，采用高分辨率X射线衍射(HRXRD)分析晶体取向与应变状态，结合表面形貌表征揭示裂纹形成机制。
AI.result: 外延层表面光滑但有条纹，纳米级粗糙度随厚度增加；从初始阶段就形成(-401)取向而非(001)取向；面内[104]方向理论最大拉伸应变约+4.1%，驱动垂直于该方向的裂纹形成。
AI.conclusion: 外延层与衬底的特定取向关系是由氧-rich MOCVD条件下(001)表面通过小面重构以降低表面能所致，这为理解Ga2O3外延生长中的取向控制与裂纹抑制提供了关键见解。

title: The evolution of AI from image interpretation toward scientific inference in nanoparticle electron microscopy
comment: Main article: 34 pages, 8 figures (including Graphical Abstract), 5 tables. Appendix: 18 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. This manuscript has been submitted (after invitation) to Advanced Intelligent Discovery for peer review
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming electron microscopy by enabling quantitative analysis of increasingly large and complex datasets for nanoparticle characterization. Recent advances in machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) have expanded microscopy from a descriptive imaging technique into a data-driven platform for structural interpretation, dynamic analysis, and scientific inference. This review examines AI methodologies for nanoparticle electron microscopy, focusing on transmission electron microscopy (TEM), high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM), scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), and in situ TEM. The discussion is organized around the principal challenges in nanoparticle characterization, including particle detection, segmentation, morphology quantification, atomic-resolution restoration, defect identification, two-dimensional-to-three-dimensional structural inference, and analysis of dynamic processes in situ. We review computational approaches from conventional ML and convolutional neural networks to transformer architectures, self-supervised learning, foundation models, multimodal AI, and physics-informed learning. We further discuss integrating microscopy data with simulations, metadata, and autonomous experimentation to relate nanoparticle structure, dynamics, synthesis conditions, and functional properties. The advantages, limitations, benchmarking, and data requirements of current methodologies are critically assessed. Finally, emerging opportunities for foundation models, AI-guided microscopy, closed-loop experimentation, and autonomous materials discovery are discussed. By integrating advances across computer vision, materials informatics, and electron microscopy, this review highlights the role of AI in next-generation nanoparticle characterization and accelerated materials discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了人工智能（AI）在纳米粒子电子显微学中的应用，涵盖目标检测、分割、形貌量化、原子级重构、缺陷识别、2D到3D结构推断及原位动态分析等关键挑战，并讨论了从传统机器学习到Transformer、自监督学习、基础模型、多模态AI及物理信息学习等计算方法，最后展望了AI引导显微镜、闭环实验及自主材料发现等新兴机遇。
AI.motivation: 电子显微镜数据日益庞大复杂，传统分析方法难以高效处理，亟需AI方法实现从描述性成像到数据驱动定量分析的转变，从而加速纳米粒子表征与材料发现。
AI.method: 系统综述了多种AI/ML/DL方法，包括卷积神经网络、Transformer、自监督学习、基础模型、多模态AI和物理信息学习，并讨论了将显微数据与仿真、元数据及自主实验相结合的策略。
AI.result: 梳理了AI在TEM、HRTEM、STEM及原位TEM中针对粒子检测、分割、形貌量化、原子级重构、缺陷识别、2D-3D推断和动态分析等方面的现有成果，并评估了各方法的优势、局限及数据需求。
AI.conclusion: AI正将电子显微学从描述性工具转变为数据驱动平台，未来基础模型、AI引导显微镜和闭环自主实验将在纳米粒子表征与加速材料发现中发挥关键作用。

title: Connecting Diffuse Scattering to Atomic-Site-Resolved Occupancy and Displacement Fields through Fourier Filtering
summary: Local structural correlations are encoded in diffuse scattering, but identifying atomic motifs that produce specific diffuse features can be challenging. We introduce MOSAIC, a computational framework for this task when an atomistic configuration is available and a phase-bearing scattering amplitude can be calculated. Our approach relies on applying the Fourier filter to this amplitude over the reciprocal-space regions encompassing the scattering features of interest to obtain maps of atomic displacements and site occupancies responsible for those features. The method is effective in interrogating the nature and spatial distributions of interatomic correlations in large-scale structural models, such as obtained using Reverse Monte Carlo refinements from experimental data, molecular dynamics, or Monte Carlo simulations, or 2D structural projections derived from atomic-resolution electron microscopy images.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC是一种计算框架，通过对相位承载散射振幅进行傅里叶滤波，从原子构型中识别产生特定漫散射特征的局域结构关联，适用于RMC、MD、MC模拟及电镜图像等大尺度结构模型。
AI.motivation: 漫散射中编码了局域结构关联信息，但从中识别产生特定散射特征的原子基序（atomic motifs）具有挑战性，现有方法难以直接建立散射特征与原子位移/占位模式之间的对应关系。
AI.method: MOSAIC框架的核心是在已有原子构型且可计算相位承载散射振幅的前提下，对倒易空间中目标散射特征区域的振幅施加傅里叶滤波，将滤波后的结果反变换回实空间，从而得到导致这些特征的原子位移图和占位图。
AI.result: 该方法能够有效揭示大尺度结构模型中原子间关联的性质和空间分布，可应用于多种来源的结构模型（实验RMC精修、分子动力学、蒙特卡洛模拟、二维电镜投影）。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC提供了一种系统化的手段，将倒易空间的漫散射特征直接映射回实空间的原子级结构信息，为理解局域结构有序性及其与散射现象的关联提供了有效工具。

title: Surface Variables Description of Axion Topological Materials
summary: We study the response of axion topological materials under the presence of external static electric and magnetic fields. We focus on the macroscopic quasi-static magnetoelectric response of topological insulators. We use techniques based on surface variables that have been previously employed in soft condensed matter problems for the description of heterogeneous systems composed of multiple homogeneous materials. A complete description of the whole system is written in terms of surface degrees of freedom, which in this case correspond to effective surface charge and surface current densities. We obtain a set of integral equations satisfied by these variables. We present exact analytic solutions for axial-symmetric cases. We develop a numerical method for the solution of the integral equations by means of a boundary finite element method. We apply the numerical method to topological insulators with different geometries such as spheres, hollow spheres and toroidal surfaces. We show that that a variational principle can be used to recover the surface variables equations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了轴子拓扑材料在外部静电场和静磁场下的磁电响应，使用基于表面变量的方法（源自软凝聚态物质问题）描述多材料异质系统，推导出表面电荷和电流密度的积分方程，给出了轴对称情形的解析解，并开发了边界有限元数值方法，应用于球体、空心球体和环面等不同几何形状的拓扑绝缘体。
AI.motivation: 研究拓扑绝缘体在外部静态电磁场作用下的准静态磁电响应，特别是如何用表面变量方法统一描述多材料组成的异质系统。
AI.method: 借鉴软凝聚态物质中用于描述多材料异质系统的表面变量技术，将整个系统用表面自由度（有效表面电荷和表面电流密度）描述，推导积分方程，对轴对称情形给出解析解，并开发边界有限元数值方法求解。
AI.result: 获得了表面变量满足的积分方程组；给出了轴对称情形的精确解析解；开发了边界有限元数值方法；成功应用于球体、空心球体和环面等不同几何形状的拓扑绝缘体。
AI.conclusion: 表面变量方法可以有效描述拓扑绝缘体的磁电响应，且可以通过变分原理恢复表面变量方程，为处理复杂几何形状的拓扑材料提供了理论框架和数值工具。

title: Anisotropic hot carrier relaxation mediated by electron phonon scattering in TiN thin films
summary: Crystal orientations can shape the ultrafast energy relaxations of transition-metal nitride thin films. Here, we investigate the orientation-dependent electron-phonon (e-ph) mediated relaxation in titanium nitride (TiN) thin films along the [100], [110], and [111] directions by combining first-principles calculations with ultrafast pump-probe transient absorption spectroscopy. Using maximally localized Wannier functions, we evaluate e-ph quasiparticle scattering lifetimes near the Fermi level and identify a clear anisotropy: The TiN [111] orientation exhibits a longer e-ph scattering lifetime (15.96 fs) than [100] (13.69 fs) and [110] (11.12 fs), indicating reduced intrinsic e-ph scattering strength. Furthermore, we grew quasi-epitaxial, orientation-controlled TiN thin films on MgO substrates. Pump-probe measurements reveals that the population-level relaxation (hot-electron cooling) time also depends on orientations, with [111] films showing a significantly slower decay (110 fs) than [100] (90 fs) and [110] (80 fs). We emphasize that the calculated few-femtosecond scattering lifetimes and the measured few-hundred-femtosecond cooling time respectively represent single-event scattering and collective cooling, yet they exhibit consistent trends. These results demonstrate that crystallographic orientation provides a practical and powerful route to tune e-ph-governed relaxation in TiN thin films, offering essential design guidelines for refractory plasmonic and energy-conversion platforms.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合第一性原理计算和超快泵浦-探测光谱，揭示了氮化钛（TiN）薄膜中电子-声子弛豫的显著各向异性：沿[111]方向的散射寿命（15.96 fs）和冷却时间（110 fs）均长于[100]和[110]方向，表明晶体取向可有效调控超快能量弛豫过程。
AI.motivation: 探究过渡金属氮化物薄膜中晶体取向如何影响超快能量弛豫，为耐火等离子体和能量转换平台提供设计指导。
AI.method: 第一性原理计算（利用最大局域化Wannier函数评估电子-声子准粒子散射寿命）+ 超快泵浦-探测瞬态吸收光谱（测量准外延生长在MgO衬底上的取向可控TiN薄膜的热电子冷却时间）。
AI.conclusion: 晶体取向是调控TiN薄膜中电子-声子弛豫的实用且有效的途径，为耐火等离子体和能量转换平台提供了关键设计依据。

title: Nonlinear Tellegen limit
summary: The Tellegen limit is the fundamental electromagnetic stability bound on magnetoelectric media. We show that nonlinear magnetoelectric coupling gives rise to a new Tellegen limit, which we term the nonlinear Tellegen limit. Unlike the linear Tellegen limit, which is fixed by material parameters, the nonlinear Tellegen limit is field-tunable -- a static electric or magnetic field drives the system toward electromagnetic instability at a material-specific critical field determined by the magnetic point group symmetry. The approach to this limit is accompanied by a field-tunable Faraday rotation that grows linearly with the applied field and is bounded from above by a universal maximum set by the nonlinear Tellegen limit -- beyond which the medium becomes electromagnetically unstable. We demonstrate the nonlinear Tellegen limit and the field-space stability phase diagram in two magnetically ordered material systems -- a d-wave altermagnet and an M-type hexagonal ferrite -- showing that the symmetry of the magnetic point group governs both the structure of the nonlinear magnetoelectric tensor and the resulting electromagnetic instability.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了非线性磁电耦合中存在一个场可调的Tellegen极限（非线性Tellegen极限），它不同于线性极限的固定材料参数，而是可以通过静态电场或磁场驱动系统达到电磁不稳定性，并伴随有上界受该极限约束的场可调法拉第旋转。作者在d波交变磁体和M型六角铁氧体中演示了这一现象。
AI.motivation: 探索非线性磁电耦合下的电磁稳定性边界，揭示其与线性Tellegen极限的本质区别，并建立场可调的非线性Tellegen极限理论。
AI.method: 通过理论分析非线性磁电耦合张量的结构，结合磁点群对称性，推导非线性Tellegen极限，并在d波交变磁体和M型六角铁氧体两种磁有序材料系统中进行演示验证。
AI.result: 1) 发现非线性Tellegen极限是场可调的，存在材料特定的临界场；2) 法拉第旋转随外加场线性增长，其上界由非线性Tellegen极限设定；3) 磁点群对称性决定了非线性磁电张量的结构及电磁不稳定性的特征。
AI.conclusion: 非线性Tellegen极限是磁电介质中一种普适的电磁稳定性边界，其场可调特性为电磁功能材料的设计提供了新的自由度，磁点群对称性是调控这一极限的关键因素。

title: Spinel Ferrite-Based Materials for Electrochemical Applications: Synthesis, Applications, and Future Perspectives
summary: Spinel ferrites have shown wide range of applications in various fields, including supercapacitors, Li-ion batteries, water splitting, chemical sensors, catalytic activity, high-frequency magnetic devices, and biomedical, hyperthermia, drug delivery applications., etc. This review focuses on the latest progress and trends on design of spinel ferrites (MFe2O4; M = Divalent transition metal ion) based materials for electrochemical applications. Spinel ferrites exhibit good chemical stability, high surface area and excellent electrochemical behaviour with their multiple oxidation states, making them suitable for the detection of a wide range of gaseous analytes including volatile organic compounds, heavy metal ions, biomolecules, and environmental pollutants. It also makes spinel ferrites a great choice for efficient energy storage and utility in supercapacitors. The electrochemical performance of spinel ferrite-based electrode materials can be effectively tuned via morphology control, incorporation of carbon-based materials, compositional substitution, doping and forming composition systems, especially in nanostructured form. This review will serve as a comprehensive resource for researchers interested in the synthesis and various enhancement techniques for electrode material composition of electrochemical device applications specifically, gas sensors and supercapacitors, which are two of the highest emerging functional applications for the new sustainability directed world, utilizing these advanced materials.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述聚焦于尖晶石铁氧体（MFe2O4）基材料在电化学应用中的最新进展，特别关注其在气体传感器和超级电容器两大新兴可持续功能领域的应用，并讨论了通过形貌调控、碳材料复合、元素掺杂等策略提升其电化学性能的方法。
AI.motivation: 尖晶石铁氧体在超级电容器、锂离子电池、水分解、化学传感器、生物医学等多个领域具有广泛应用前景，但其电化学性能需要进一步提升。本文旨在系统综述尖晶石铁氧体基材料在电化学应用中的最新进展和设计趋势，为相关研究人员提供全面参考。
AI.method: 本文采用综述方法，系统梳理了尖晶石铁氧体基电极材料的多种性能增强策略，包括：形貌控制、引入碳基材料、成分取代、掺杂以及形成复合体系，特别关注纳米结构形式下的优化设计。
AI.result: 尖晶石铁氧体凭借良好的化学稳定性、高比表面积、多氧化态及优异的电化学行为，适用于检测VOCs、重金属离子、生物分子等气体分析物，同时在超级电容器中表现出高效的储能性能。通过多种调控手段可有效优化其电化学性能。
AI.conclusion: 这篇综述为从事电化学器件（特别是气体传感器和超级电容器）电极材料合成与改性的研究人员提供了全面的参考资料，指出尖晶石铁氧体是面向可持续世界的高功能性材料。

title: Strain-controlled crystalline--amorphous transition and flat-band tuning in buckled silicon kagome
summary: Electronic flat bands in an elemental two-dimensional material provide an attractive setting for electron interactions competing with suppressed kinetic energy. Here we propose a buckled silicon kagome lattice (SiKL), an unfunctionalized six-atom monolayer of bond-linked Si$_3$ triangles and dodecagonal pores. Its planar parent hosts a dispersionless Kohn--Sham band near the Fermi level but is unstable to out-of-plane distortions. Following three soft zone-centre phonons and relaxing displaced structures yields two nearly degenerate buckled forms. The high-buckling form retains a partially flat kagome-derived band near the Fermi level. Biaxial tension controls lattice dynamics and electronic dispersion: at 10% strain, the bandwidth decreases significantly, the density-of-states peak approaches the Fermi level, and the softest phonon hardens. At 315 K, $6\times6$ ab initio MD shows the unstrained network disordering while the strained network remains ordered, indicating finite-temperature metastability. Fifty-nanosecond classical MD of $36\times36$ sheets reveals a strain-controlled crystalline--amorphous transition and local-bonding crossover near 2% strain. Low-strain trajectories show gradual, two-stage disordering; higher strains undergo an abrupt, first-order-like collapse, with the transition temperature reaching approximately 600 K at 10% strain. An exploratory Ag(111) substrate model suggests epitaxial mismatch could supply comparable tension, retain a narrow SiKL band, and preserve crystalline order above room temperature. Unlike passivated or hybrid-lattice silicon kagome proposals aimed mainly at conventional semiconductors, SiKL is elemental and uses strain alone to couple thermal metastability, bond rearrangement, and near-Fermi flat-band tuning. Buckled SiKL is a candidate platform for strain-controlled flat-band and electronic correlation physics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种未功能化的屈曲硅Kagome晶格（SiKL）单层材料，具有色散平坦的电子能带。通过应变调控，该材料可在高温下保持亚稳态，并实现从晶态到非晶态的转变，为研究应变控制下的平带物理和电子关联效应提供了候选平台。
AI.motivation: 二维材料中的电子平带为电子相互作用提供了理想环境，但现有硅基Kagome方案多需要钝化或杂化处理。作者希望获得一种纯元素、无需功能化的硅Kagome体系，并能通过应变独立调控其热亚稳态、键重排和近费米能级平带。
AI.method: 通过第一性原理计算识别软声子模式并进行结构弛豫，得到两种近简并的屈曲构型。利用双轴应变调控晶格动力学和电子色散，结合从头算分子动力学（AIMD）和经典分子动力学（MD）模拟评估热稳定性及晶态-非晶态转变。
AI.result: 高屈曲构型在费米能级附近保留部分平带。10%应变下带宽显著减小，态密度峰接近费米能级，软声子硬化。315K下无应变结构无序化而应变结构保持有序。经典MD表明存在应变控制的晶态-非晶转变，低应变下缓慢二阶段无序化，高应变下发生一阶类突变坍缩，转变温度在10%应变时达~600K。Ag(111)基底模型显示外延失配可提供类似应变。
AI.conclusion: 屈曲SiKL是一种纯元素、仅通过应变即可耦合热亚稳态、键重排和近费米平带调谐的平台材料，为应变控制下的平带物理和电子关联效应研究提供了新候选体系。

title: High-Quality Ge-Doped (010) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Homoepitaxial Films Grown by Low-pressure CVD: Structural, Electrical, and Schottky Diode Characteristics
summary: In this work, Ge-doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ homoepitaxial films were grown on native (010) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ substrates using low-pressure chemical vapor deposition (LPCVD). Controlled $n$-type doping was achieved with room-temperature carrier concentrations ranging from $7.4\times10^{17}$ to $2.57\times10^{18}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-3}$ and corresponding electron mobilities of 105-62 cm$^2$/V$\cdot$s. The films exhibited smooth surface morphology with RMS roughness values of 2.94-3.97 nm, while X-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy confirmed phase-pure $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ with excellent crystalline quality and near-stoichiometric composition. Temperature-dependent Hall measurements on the film with a room-temperature carrier concentration of $7.4\times10^{17}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-3}$ and mobility of 105 cm$^2$/V$\cdot$s yielded a peak electron mobility of 234 cm$^2$/V$\cdot$s at 116 K, while charge-neutrality and transport modeling revealed a dominant shallow donor level with an activation energy of 14 meV, confirming efficient electrical activation of Ge donors. Vertical Ni/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Schottky barrier diodes fabricated using the Ge-doped drift layer exhibited good rectifying behavior with a turn-on voltage of 0.74 V, an ideality factor of 1.32, a Schottky barrier height of 1.02 eV, and a specific on-resistance of 2.49 m$Ω\cdot$cm$^2$. Capacitance-voltage measurements yielded a net donor concentration of $7.7\times10^{17}\ \mathrm{cm}^{-3}$ and a Schottky barrier height of 1.13 eV, in good agreement with Hall and current-voltage measurements. These results demonstrate that LPCVD enables controllable Ge doping while maintaining high structural and electronic quality, establishing LPCVD-grown Ge-doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ as a promising platform for future high-voltage power electronic devices.

AI.tldr: 本文采用低压化学气相沉积（LPCVD）在(010) β-Ga₂O₃衬底上生长Ge掺杂同质外延薄膜，实现了可控n型掺杂（室温载流子浓度7.4×10¹⁷–2.57×10¹⁸ cm⁻³，迁移率105–62 cm²/V·s），并制备了性能良好的Ni/β-Ga₂O₃肖特基势垒二极管（开启电压0.74 V，理想因子1.32，比导通电阻2.49 mΩ·cm²），证明了LPCVD生长的Ge掺杂β-Ga₂O₃是高压功率电子器件的有前景平台。
AI.motivation: β-Ga₂O₃因其超宽带隙（~4.8 eV）和高压击穿场强，是下一代高压功率电子器件的候选材料。然而，实现可控n型掺杂并保持高质量外延生长是实际应用的关键。Ge掺杂相比传统Si掺杂具有更低激活能和更好热稳定性，但对其在LPCVD生长β-Ga₂O₃中的系统研究仍不充分。
AI.method: 采用低压化学气相沉积（LPCVD）在(010) β-Ga₂O₃衬底上生长Ge掺杂同质外延薄膜，通过控制Ge掺杂浓度调节电学性能。利用Hall效应、X射线衍射、拉曼光谱、X射线光电子能谱等对薄膜进行表征，并制备垂直Ni/β-Ga₂O₃肖特基势垒二极管进行器件性能评估。
AI.result: 室温下载流子浓度7.4×10¹⁷–2.57×10¹⁸ cm⁻³，迁移率105–62 cm²/V·s；薄膜RMS粗糙度2.94–3.97 nm，相纯β相且近化学计量比；低温（116 K）峰值迁移率234 cm²/V·s；施主激活能14 meV；肖特基二极管开启电压0.74 V，理想因子1.32，势垒高度1.02 eV，比导通电阻2.49 mΩ·cm²。
AI.conclusion: LPCVD能够实现可控的Ge掺杂，同时保持β-Ga₂O₃薄膜的高结构质量和电子质量，证明LPCVD生长的Ge掺杂β-Ga₂O₃是未来高压功率电子器件的有前景平台。

title: High-Mobility Ge-Doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Growth on Sapphire by Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition
summary: In this work, high-quality Ge-doped (-201) $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ thin films were heteroepitaxially grown on c-plane sapphire substrates with offcut angles of 0 deg, 2 deg, 6 deg, and 8 deg using low-pressure chemical vapor deposition (LPCVD). Increasing sapphire offcut promoted step-flow growth, resulting in improved terrace alignment, reduced surface roughness, and enhanced crystalline quality. Phase-pure monoclinic $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ with strong (-201) preferential orientation was confirmed by X-ray diffraction and Raman spectroscopy, while X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy revealed near-stoichiometric composition with an O/Ga ratio of 1.48. Electrical transport properties exhibited a strong dependence on substrate offcut angle, with room-temperature Hall mobility increasing from 15 to 117 cm$^2$/V s as the offcut angle increased from 0 deg to 6 deg, across carrier concentrations spanning $1.43 \times 10^{17}$ to $2.75 \times 10^{18}$ cm$^{-3}$. The 6 deg offcut sample achieved a room-temperature mobility of 117 cm$^2$/V s at a carrier concentration of $1.43 \times 10^{17}$ cm$^{-3}$ and a peak low-temperature mobility of 337 cm$^2$/V s at 128 K with a carrier concentration of $8.96 \times 10^{16}$ cm$^{-3}$, representing the highest reported room-temperature and low-temperature mobilities for Ge-doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ films grown on sapphire substrates. Carrier concentration and mobility data were analyzed using charge-neutrality and Boltzmann transport models incorporating donor activation together with polar optical phonon, ionized impurity, neutral impurity, acoustic deformation potential, and dislocation scattering mechanisms. The fitting revealed shallow donor activation energies of 12.5-19 meV, a deeper donor level at 80 meV, low acceptor compensation ($< 5 \times 10^{15}$ cm$^{-3}$), and threading dislocation densities on the order of $10^9$ cm$^{-2}$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过LPCVD在具有不同离切角（0°-8°）的c面蓝宝石衬底上异质外延生长了高质量Ge掺杂β-Ga₂O₃薄膜。研究发现，6°离切角样品在室温下实现了117 cm²/V s的迁移率，载流子浓度为1.43×10¹⁷ cm⁻³，低温下（128 K）达到337 cm²/V s，这是目前蓝宝石衬底上Ge掺杂β-Ga₂O₃薄膜报道的最高值。
AI.motivation: β-Ga₂O₃作为超宽禁带半导体在功率电子器件中具有巨大潜力，但高质量的异质外延生长仍是挑战。本研究旨在通过调控蓝宝石衬底的离切角度，优化Ge掺杂β-Ga₂O₃薄膜的晶体质量和电学输运特性，以期获得更高的载流子迁移率。
AI.method: 采用低压化学气相沉积（LPCVD）在离切角分别为0°、2°、6°和8°的c面蓝宝石衬底上异质外延生长Ge掺杂β-Ga₂O₃薄膜。利用XRD、Raman光谱、XPS等进行结构表征，通过Hall效应测量电学性质，并采用电中性模型和玻尔兹曼输运模型拟合载流子浓度与迁移率数据，考虑了多种散射机制。
AI.result: 增加蓝宝石离切角促进了台阶流生长，改善了表面形貌和晶体质量。6°离切角样品获得最佳电学性能：室温迁移率117 cm²/V s（载流子浓度1.43×10¹⁷ cm⁻³），低温峰值迁移率337 cm²/V s（128 K，载流子浓度8.96×10¹⁶ cm⁻³）。拟合得到浅施主激活能12.5-19 meV、深施主能级80 meV、低受主补偿浓度（<5×10¹⁵ cm⁻³）以及约10⁹ cm⁻²的位错密度。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化蓝宝石衬底离切角至6°，成功实现了蓝宝石衬底上Ge掺杂β-Ga₂O₃薄膜的最高室温及低温迁移率记录，证明离切角调控是改善异质外延β-Ga₂O₃薄膜电学性能的有效策略。

title: A Cluster-Based Model of the Spectrum of Erbium-Doped GdVO$_4$
summary: Experimental observations of rare-earth ions doped into an antiferromagnetic crystal show an enriched optical spectrum. In this paper we present a cluster-based model to describe erbium ions doped into a gadolinium vanadate (Er:GdVO$_4$) host crystal, wherein the erbium ion couples directly to its four nearest neighbour gadolinium ions, which in turn couple to the mean field of the rest of the crystal. Compared to previous models in the literature, the parameters used to fit this model are fewer in number, with clearer physical origins. Agreement with the experimentally observed optical spectrum of Er:GdVO$_4$ suggests that our model succeeds in capturing the most important interactions of the system, suggesting that it may be useful for predicting microwave-to-optical transduction in future experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于团簇的模型来描述掺铒钒酸钆晶体（Er:GdVO₄）中铒离子的光学光谱，该模型参数更少、物理意义更清晰，能成功捕捉最重要的相互作用，有望用于预测微波-光学转换。
AI.motivation: 稀土离子掺杂反铁磁晶体的实验观测显示出丰富的光学光谱，现有模型参数较多且物理起源不够清晰，需要更简洁有效的模型来描述该系统。
AI.method: 建立团簇模型：铒离子直接与最近邻的四个钆离子耦合，这些钆离子再与晶体的其余部分通过平均场耦合。
AI.result: 模型与实验观测的Er:GdVO₄光学光谱吻合良好，参数数量更少且物理起源更清晰。
AI.conclusion: 该模型成功捕捉了系统最重要的相互作用，可能对未来预测微波-光学转换实验有用。

title: Measurement of Kerr rotation using a variable-angle polarizer method
summary: The magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) occurs when polarized light reflects from a magnetized surface, causing a small change in the polarization angle and state. Measurement of the rotation in the angle (Kerr rotation) is well established and typically performed close to the null configuration in a polarizer-analyzer geometry. However, accurate measurement always remains a challenge and as the effect depends intricately on several optical parameters. Here we performed a series of longitudinal magneto-optical Kerr effect (MOKE) measurements on $p$ and $s$ polarized laser light at various polarizer angles on a Cobalt thin film and measured the orthogonal components of the reflected polarized light using a Wollaston prism. Analytical expressions for the orthogonal light components were fitted to the average intensity and the MOKE signal measured at different polarizer angles to obtain the Kerr roations. Our analysis yielded a $p (s)$-Kerr rotation of 0.46 (0.65) milliradians for a 633~nm laser at 45$^\circ$ angle of incidence, which agrees very well with our estimated value for Co using available literature data. Apart from being very accurate, the advantage of the process is that it eliminates the inherent uncertainties in single-point measurements of the Kerr rotation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过测量正交光分量并拟合解析表达式来精确获取磁光克尔旋转角的方法，在钴薄膜上测得的p和s偏振克尔旋转分别为0.46和0.65毫弧度，与文献数据高度吻合。
AI.motivation: 磁光克尔效应（MOKE）中偏振角的微小变化（克尔旋转）测量一直存在挑战，传统单点测量方法存在固有不准确性，且结果复杂依赖于多种光学参数，因此需要更精确、更鲁棒的测量方法。
AI.method: 在钴薄膜上使用p和s偏振激光进行纵向MOKE测量，在不同偏振器角度下利用沃拉斯顿棱镜测量反射光的正交分量，将正交光分量的解析表达式拟合到平均强度和MOKE信号上，从而得到克尔旋转角。
AI.result: 对于633 nm激光在45°入射角下，p偏振和s偏振的克尔旋转分别为0.46毫弧度和0.65毫弧度，与基于文献数据估算的值高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅准确性高，而且消除了单点测量克尔旋转时存在的固有不准确性，是一种更可靠的MOKE测量方案。

title: Telecom-band Chiral Light Detection through Hidden Giant Third-Order Nonlinear Circular Dichroism in Two-dimensional Halide Perovskite
summary: Chiral nonlinear optical (NLO) responses enable efficient discrimination of circularly polarized light (CPL) and are attracting increasing interest for optical and optoelectronic technologies. However, studies on NLO properties in chiral materials have largely focused on second-order NLO processes, while the role of chirality in third-order NLO processes remains poorly explored. Here, we demonstrate telecom-band CPL detection by third harmonic generation circular dichroism (THG-CD) in the chiral two-dimensional perovskite (R/S-MBACl)2PbI4 and uncover a giant hidden THG-CD anisotropy that is accessible via polarization-resolved detection. Polarization-resolved THG measurements reveal that opposite chiral NLO responses emerge in orthogonal THG polarization channels. Therefore, these chiral anisotropic contributions largely cancel each other in the total-THG signal detection, leading to underestimation of the THG-CD dissymmetry in conventional evaluations based on total-THG intensity. By separating these hidden chiral contributions, we observe exceptionally large dissymmetry factors exceeding 1.9 and achieve selective extraction of chiral NLO responses with opposite handedness, without any structural chiral inversion. These findings highlight the importance of polarization-resolved analysis for evaluating more accurate chiral NLO responses inherent to the material and provide a promising platform for optical information processing, encryption, and anti-counterfeiting technologies at technologically relevant telecommunication wavelengths.

AI.tldr: 本文在手性二维钙钛矿(R/S-MBACl)2PbI4中发现了通过三次谐波产生圆二色性（THG-CD）实现电信波段圆偏振光检测的新方法。通过偏振分辨检测，揭示了传统方法中被总THG信号掩盖的巨大隐藏THG-CD各向异性，实现了超过1.9的不对称因子，为光信息处理和防伪技术提供了新平台。
AI.motivation: 目前手性非线性光学研究主要集中于二阶非线性过程，而三阶非线性过程中手性角色的研究十分匮乏。作者希望探索手性材料在三阶非线性光学过程中的作用，特别是实现通信波段（电信波段）的圆偏振光检测。
AI.method: 以手性二维钙钛矿(R/S-MBACl)2PbI4为材料，通过偏振分辨的三次谐波产生（THG）测量，分析正交THG偏振通道中的手性非线性光学响应，将隐藏的手性各向异性贡献从总THG信号中分离出来。
AI.result: 在手性二维钙钛矿中观测到巨大的THG-CD不对称因子，超过1.9；发现传统基于总THG强度的评估方法会因不同偏振通道中的手性贡献相互抵消而低估实际手性响应；通过偏振分辨分析可选择性提取不同手性的非线性光学响应。
AI.conclusion: 偏振分辨分析对于准确评估材料固有的手性非线性光学响应至关重要。该研究不仅填补了三阶非线性过程中手性效应的研究空白，还为电信波段的（1550 nm附近）光学信息处理、加密和防伪技术提供了有前景的平台。

title: Neural-network-based reconstruction of spin and orbital angular momentum from X-ray magnetic circular dichroism spectra
summary: X-ray magnetic circular dichroism (XMCD) is a powerful probe of element-specific spin and orbital angular momentum. Conventional analyses based on sum rules, however, rely on integrated spectral intensities and can become insufficient when multiple parameters influence the spectral line shape. Here, we formulate XMCD analysis as an inverse problem and develop a neural-network (NN) based approach to reconstruct spin and orbital angular momentum directly from full spectral line shapes. Using many-body multiplet calculations of Fe, Co, and Ni $L_{2,3}$-edge X-ray absorption spectra (XAS) and XMCD spectra as a physically well-defined training dataset, we systematically vary key parameters including crystal-field splitting, spin--orbit coupling, and exchange field. The NN is trained to map spectral line shapes onto the expectation values of spin and orbital angular momentm $\langle S_z \rangle$ and $\langle L_z \rangle$, and validated using strictly test-only data. The results demonstrate accurate and unbiased reconstruction, establishing a proof of concept for data-driven inverse reconstruction from XAS and XMCD spectra. These findings show that exploiting the full XAS and XMCD line shapes provide access to information beyond conventional sum-rule analyses while remaining consistent with established theoretical frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络的X射线磁圆二色性（XMCD）分析方法，直接从全谱线形状重建自旋和轨道角动量，克服了传统求和规则依赖积分强度的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统XMCD分析基于求和规则，依赖积分谱强度，当多个参数影响谱线形状时精度不足，亟需更精确的逆向重构方法。
AI.method: 将XMCD分析形式化为逆问题，基于多体多重态计算构建Fe、Co、Ni的L_{2,3}边XAS和XMCD训练数据集，系统变化晶场劈裂、自旋-轨道耦合和交换场等关键参数，训练神经网络从谱线形状直接映射到自旋和轨道角动量期望值。
AI.result: 神经网络能够准确且无偏地从全谱线形状重构⟨S_z⟩和⟨L_z⟩，在严格测试集上验证有效，精度优于传统求和规则方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用完整的XAS和XMCD谱线形状可以获取超出传统求和规则分析的信息，为数据驱动的X射线谱逆向重构建立了概念验证。

title: Effect of annealing temperature on the structure and properties of co-sputtered Fe-Mn-Sn films near 2:1:1 ratio
summary: Research in recent years has focused on the thin-film synthesis of high-quality ternary alloys, identified for their tunable properties and potential in spintronics (e.g., Heusler alloys, Kagome magnets). In a previous study, we identified the conditions for stabilizing Fe$_2$MnSn, a Kagome magnet with a high Curie temperature and magnetic anisotropy. However, ternary phases such as Fe$_2$MnSn are challenging to synthesize and stabilize within a narrow temperature window, as binary and elemental phases can also form during the growth process. To highlight these observations, we investigated the thin film phases in the Fe-Mn-Sn system near the 2:1:1 ratio as a function of annealing temperature, ranging from 400 to 700\degree C. The elemental Fe, Mn, and Sn targets were pre-calibrated to a close to 2:1:1 ratio and co-sputtered at room temperature, followed by annealing. Two binary hexagonal structures, Fe$_3$Sn$_2$ and Fe$_5$Sn$_3$, along with the elemental Fe phase, are stabilized between 400-550\degree C, but disappear at 580\degree C, where Fe$_2$MnSn is the only stable phase. Elemental Mn phase starts to appear starting from 600\degree C, and becomes dominant by 750\degree C. Electrical, magnetic and magneto-optical properties are observed to correlate with the structural findings and the best properties are observed in the temperature range where Fe$_2$MnSn is the dominant phase. In general, our study highlights the difficulty in growing phase-pure ternary alloys such as Fe$_2$MnSn, which is very strongly based on precise temperature conditions. We also observed significant disordered growth below 100 nm for Fe$_2$MnSn, implying poor thickness scaling behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统探究了Fe-Mn-Sn体系中2:1:1比例薄膜在不同退火温度（400-700°C）下的相变过程，发现Fe₂MnSn仅在580°C附近稳定存在，低温（400-550°C）出现二元相和单质相，高温（600°C+）则Mn相占主导，且Fe₂MnSn在100 nm以下存在显著无序生长，揭示了精确温度控制对合成纯相三元合金的关键性和厚度缩放的不良行为。
AI.motivation: 三元合金（如Kagome磁体Fe₂MnSn）虽具有高居里温度和磁各向异性等优异性能，但合成难度大、稳定窗口窄，易出现二元相和单质相，亟需系统研究其生长条件与相稳定性。
AI.method: 采用Fe、Mn、Sn靶材共溅射至接近2:1:1比例，室温沉积后在不同温度（400-700°C）下退火，通过结构、电学、磁性和磁光性质表征分析相演变。
AI.result: 二元相（Fe₃Sn₂、Fe₅Sn₃）和Fe单质在400-550°C稳定；580°C时Fe₂MnSn为唯一稳定相；600°C以上Mn单质出现并逐渐主导。电学、磁性和磁光性质在Fe₂MnSn主导时最优；Fe₂MnSn在100 nm以下存在显著无序生长。
AI.conclusion: Fe₂MnSn的纯相合成对退火温度极为敏感，窗口极窄，且厚度缩放行为差，揭示了生长高纯度三元合金薄膜的核心挑战在于精确控温。

title: A Generalized Frank-Bilby Equation for Interfaces in Crystalline Materials
summary: The classical Frank-Bilby equation (FBE) is commonly used to predict the structure of interfaces in crystalline materials in terms of interfacial dislocation networks. However, in general, the line defects in interfaces are disconnections, possessing both dislocation and step character, which are not captured by the classical FBE. As a result, the FBE cannot fully describe the structure of most interfaces of practical interest. To address this issue, we derive a generalized Frank-Bilby equation (GFBE) that explicitly incorporates both dislocation and step components of interfacial defects. We demonstrate its application to several representative interface systems.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了广义Frank-Bilby方程(GFBE)，该方程同时考虑了界面缺陷的位错和台阶特征，弥补了经典Frank-Bilby方程(FBE)只能描述位错网络而忽略台阶特征的不足。
AI.motivation: 经典Frank-Bilby方程(FBE)只能描述界面位错网络，但实际界面中的线缺陷通常是兼具位错和台阶特征的"位错台阶"(disconnections)，FBE无法全面描述这类具有实际意义的界面结构。
AI.method: 推导了广义Frank-Bilby方程(GFBE)，明确将界面缺陷的位错分量和台阶分量都纳入方程中。
AI.result: 得到了能够同时描述界面位错和台阶特征的GFBE，并在多个代表性界面体系中展示了其应用。
AI.conclusion: GFBE比经典FBE更全面地描述了实际界面结构，能够处理兼具位错和台阶特征的界面缺陷，具有更广泛的应用前景。

title: Electric field induced Berry curvature dipole in quasi-one-dimensional Bi$_4$I$_4$
summary: The nonlinear Hall effect in time-reversal symmetric materials offers a powerful probe into quantum geometry. Here, we investigate the electric-field-tunable nonlinear Hall response in few-layer $\text{Bi}_4\text{I}_4$ using comprehensive first-principles calculations across both its $α$ and $β$ phases. Guided by symmetry analysis, we track the evolution of the Berry curvature dipole (BCD) tensor from the monolayer to the bilayer configuration under an out-of-plane electric field. While the monolayer features a highly rigid band structure and modest BCD tunability, the bilayer architecture exhibits substantial field-induced band modifications, including a progressive Rashba splitting and eventual gap closure in the $β$ phase. Crucially, this field-tunability allows substantial enhancement of the BCD magnitude relative to the monolayer counterpart. Our findings establish quasi-one-dimensional bismuth halogenides as a promising platform for engineering nonlinear Hall response.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理计算研究了少层Bi₄I₄（α和β相）中电场可调的非线性霍尔效应，发现双层结构在电场下表现出显著的能带调制（Rashba劈裂和能隙闭合），其贝里曲率偶极矩（BCD）可被电场大幅增强，表明准一维铋卤化物是调控非线性霍尔响应的有前景平台。
AI.motivation: 探索时间反演对称材料中非线性霍尔效应的电场调控机制，特别是寻找能够有效增强贝里曲率偶极矩（BCD）的可调平台。
AI.method: 基于第一性原理计算，结合对称性分析，研究少层Bi₄I₄（α相和β相）在外加垂直电场下从单层到双层结构的BCD张量演化，分析能带结构变化（Rashba劈裂、能隙闭合）。
AI.result: 单层Bi₄I₄能带结构刚性较强，BCD可调性有限；双层结构在电场下能带显著变化，β相中出现Rashba劈裂并最终能隙闭合，BCD幅值相比单层大幅增强。
AI.conclusion: 准一维铋卤化物（Bi₄I₄）是工程化非线性霍尔效应的有前景平台，电场调控可在双层结构中实现BCD的显著增强。

title: Temperature dependence of charge-to-spin conversion in rhombohedral (110) bismuth thin film
summary: The amplitude of charge-to-spin conversion, namely the spin Hall effect (SHE), in bismuth (Bi) strongly depends on its crystal orientation. The conversion efficiency at room temperature in rhombohedral (110) bismuth is notably large as expected from its large spin-orbit interaction, and such a large SHE is ascribed to the large effective g-factor in bismuth [N. Fukumoto et al., Proc. Nat. Acad. Sci. 120, e2215030120 (2023)]. Despite the successful observation of the large conversion efficiency, a more detailed physical mechanism of the SHE in (110) bismuth is still elusive and under debate. In this work, we investigate the temperature dependence of charge-to-spin conversion in an epitaxial Bi(110)/Ni bilayer system using the second harmonic Hall method, revealing that both spin Hall conductivity and spin diffusion length augment with decreasing temperature. This finding suggests that spin scattering in (110) bismuth is dominated by the Elliott-Yafet mechanism, and the charge-to-spin conversion is mainly attributed to skew scattering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Bi(110)/Ni双层体系中电荷-自旋转换的温度依赖性，发现自旋霍尔电导率和自旋扩散长度均随温度降低而增大，表明自旋散射由Elliott-Yafet机制主导，电荷-自旋转换主要归因于偏斜散射。
AI.motivation: 铋(Bi)中电荷-自旋转换（自旋霍尔效应）的幅度强烈依赖于晶体取向，虽然(110)取向的铋在室温下表现出较大的转换效率，但其详细的物理机制仍不明确且存在争议，需要进一步探究。
AI.method: 采用二次谐波霍尔方法，对外延生长Bi(110)/Ni双层体系中的电荷-自旋转换进行温度依赖性研究。
AI.result: 自旋霍尔电导率和自旋扩散长度均随温度降低而增大。
AI.conclusion: (110)铋中的自旋散射由Elliott-Yafet机制主导，电荷-自旋转换主要归因于偏斜散射。

title: Impact of Electronic Energy Dissipation on Primary Radiation Damage Formation in Silicon
summary: In this work, we investigate the role of ion-electron coupling in simulations of radiation damage formation in silicon using molecular dynamics simulations within a two-temperature model. We explore predictions of a threshold-free approach to the coupling that accounts for both the electronic stopping and electron-phonon coupling using a local electron density-based formalism. We compare two different coupling functions across a range of primary knock-on atom energies using two interatomic potentials. Our results demonstrate that the functional form of the ion-electron coupling plays a critical role in determining defect production efficiency, clustering, and recombination, and must therefore be carefully considered for accurate modeling of radiation damage formation. Furthermore, we find that the impact of the coupling in particular on the recombination of defects during the cooling phase of the cascade depends on the choice of interatomic potential, emphasizing the importance of physically grounded descriptions for both electronic effects and atom-atom interactions for reliable radiation damage predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用双温度模型的分子动力学模拟，研究了硅中辐射损伤形成过程中离子-电子耦合的作用，发现耦合函数形式对缺陷产生效率、聚集和复合至关重要，且其影响依赖于所选用的原子间势函数。
AI.motivation: 为了准确模拟辐射损伤形成，需要理解离子-电子耦合在其中的作用，特别是不同的耦合函数和原子间势函数对预测结果的影响。
AI.method: 采用双温度模型下的分子动力学模拟，使用基于局域电子密度的无阈值耦合形式，同时考虑电子阻止和电子-声子耦合；比较了两种不同耦合函数，并在不同初级碰撞原子能量下使用两种原子间势函数进行模拟。
AI.result: 离子-电子耦合的函数形式对缺陷产生效率、聚集和复合行为有决定性影响；耦合对冷却阶段缺陷复合的影响取决于原子间势函数的选择。
AI.conclusion: 为了可靠的辐射损伤预测，需要物理上合理的离子-电子耦合描述以及准确的原子间相互作用势，两者缺一不可。

title: PAC Studio Machine Learning: Human-in-the-Loop Analysis of TDPAC Spectra
summary: Time-differential perturbed angular correlation (TDPAC or PAC) analysis is an ill-conditioned inverse problem in which site count, interaction type, correlated hyperfine parameters, damping, and initialization choices can produce competing numerical solutions. This software paper presents PAC Studio ML, a human-in-the-loop Python desktop environment for physics-informed inverse analysis of PAC spectra. The software integrates a Hamiltonian-based forward PAC model, user-defined synthetic training libraries, feature extraction, one-, two-, and three-site machine-learning predictors, direct parameter prediction, Auto sites model-family screening, ML-seeded nonlinear least-squares refinement, visualization, benchmarking, diagnostics, model-card reporting, and export tools. The ML component is designed to support, not replace, conventional fitting and expert interpretation by accelerating parameter exploration, suggesting plausible initialization regions, comparing site-count hypotheses, and improving reproducibility. Held-out synthetic tests demonstrate proof of operation and illustrate the unequal recoverability of PAC parameters in difficult inverse problems. Selected BiFeO3 examples demonstrate conventional, direct-ML, ML-seeded, and Auto sites workflows as software case studies, not as a complete experimental validation corpus. PAC Studio ML is therefore positioned as a supporting tool for expert PAC analysis: it improves workflow speed and diagnostic transparency while final model choice, physical constraints, and materials interpretation remain the responsibility of the researcher.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍PAC Studio ML，一个基于人机协同的Python桌面环境，用于时间微分扰动角关联（TDPAC/PAC）谱的物理信息逆向分析。该系统集成哈密顿量正向模型、机器学习预测器、自动化站点模型筛选、可视化与诊断工具，旨在加速参数探索、提升可重复性，但最终模型选择与物理解释仍由研究者负责。
AI.motivation: PAC分析是一个病态逆问题，站点计数、相互作用类型、超精细参数、阻尼及初始化选择等因素会产生竞争性的数值解。传统方法效率低且可重复性差，需要一种加速参数探索、增强诊断透明度的辅助工具。
AI.method: 集成哈密顿量正向PAC模型、用户定义合成训练库、特征提取、1-3站点ML预测器、Auto sites模型族筛选、ML种子非线性最小二乘精化、可视化、诊断、模型卡报告及导出工具。ML作为辅助而非替代传统拟合和专家解释。
AI.result: 保留测试证明系统运行可行性，展示了PAC参数在病态逆问题中恢复能力的不平等性。通过BiFeO3案例展示常规、直接ML、ML种子及Auto sites四种工作流。
AI.conclusion: PAC Studio ML定位为专家PAC分析的辅助工具：提升工作流速度与诊断透明度，但最终模型选择、物理约束及材料解释仍由研究者负责。

title: Exchange topology and criticality in ferrite and chromium spinels: a unified Monte Carlo analysis
summary: We report a unified analysis of Metropolis Monte Carlo results for two families of magnetic spinels: inverse ferrites Fe$^{3+}_{A}$[M$^{2+}$Fe$^{3+}$]$_{B}$O$_4$ (M = Co, Cu, Fe, Ni), where superexchange couples two chemically distinct sublattices, and chromium spinels $A$Cr$_2X_4$ ($A$ = Zn, Cd, Hg, $X$ = S, Se) together with the breathing-lattice chromates Li$M$Cr$_4$O$_8$ ($M$ = Ga, In), where a single Cr$^{3+}$ species occupies a corner-sharing tetrahedral network. Placing the exchange constants, transition temperatures, critical exponents, hysteresis, and magnetocaloric responses of these systems on a common footing, we introduce two reduced quantities not previously reported: the ratio $θ_{\mathrm{CW}}/T_C$ for the ferrites and the normalized ordering scale $t^{*}=k_BT_C/[J_1S(S+1)]$ for the chromium compounds. The ferrites cluster in the range $θ_{\mathrm{CW}}/T_C = 0.94$-$1.19$, close to the mean-field expectation of unity and the signature of dominant, unfrustrated A-B superexchange, and their exponents ($β= 0.20$-$0.26$, $γ= 1.23$-$1.27$, $δ= 4.76$-$4.78$) follow the three-dimensional Ising class. The chromium systems split into three regimes: $t^{*} \approx 1.4$-$1.9$ for Ising-treated sulfides, $t^{*} \approx 0.99$ for Heisenberg-treated selenides, and $t^{*} \approx 0.24$-$0.25$ for the antiferromagnetic breathing chromates, quantifying the combined suppression of $T_C$ by continuous spin symmetry and by geometric frustration. Finite-thickness simulations of Fe$_3$O$_4$ resolve a dimensionality crossover between two and four unit cells. We identify the Ising-versus-Heisenberg dependence of the predicted universality class in frustrated chromites as the principal open problem.

AI.tldr: 本文通过蒙特卡洛模拟统一分析了铁氧体（铁氧体）和铬尖晶石两类磁性尖晶石材料，引入两个新归一化量（θ_CW/T_C和t*），揭示了铁氧体遵循三维Ising类临界行为，而铬化合物因自旋对称性和几何阻挫呈现三种不同标度区域，并指出阻挫铬矿中Ising与Heisenberg普适类之争是核心开放问题。
AI.motivation: 将两类具有不同磁性机制（双亚晶格超交换 vs. 单物种四面体网络）的尖晶石家族纳入统一分析框架，引入新的归一化量揭示其标度规律，并澄清阻挫体系中的普适类争议。
AI.method: 采用Metropolis蒙特卡洛模拟，计算交换常数、相变温度、临界指数、磁滞和磁热效应；引入约化量θ_CW/T_C（铁氧体）和归一化有序标度t*=k_BT_C/[J_1S(S+1)]（铬化合物）；对Fe3O4进行有限厚度模拟以分析维度交叉。
AI.result: 铁氧体θ_CW/T_C=0.94-1.19，接近平均场预期，临界指数β=0.20-0.26, γ=1.23-1.27, δ=4.76-4.78，符合3D Ising类；铬化合物分为三个标度区间：硫化物t*≈1.4-1.9（Ising）、硒化物t*≈0.99（Heisenberg）、呼吸铬酸盐t*≈0.24-0.25（反铁磁），定量刻画了连续自旋对称性和几何阻挫对T_C的抑制；Fe3O4在2-4个单胞间发生维度交叉。
AI.conclusion: 铁氧体表现为无阻挫的A-B超交换主导，临界行为统一为3D Ising类；铬化合物的阻挫和自旋对称性导致T_C显著降低；阻挫铬矿中临界指数对Ising/Heisenberg模型的依赖性是尚未解决的核心问题。

title: Direct writing of individual quantum dots
summary: Quantum light sources capable of generating single photons are fundamental building blocks for photonic quantum technologies. In the ongoing search for an ideal quantum emitter, inorganic halide perovskite nanocrystals have emerged as a promising source of single photons. Their unique optical response, with an unmatched ease of synthetic tunability, stands out amongst the competing platforms. However, their stochastic dispersion in solution challenges the deterministic and stable integration of individual emitters with photonic structures that is required for practical technologies. Notably, resolution and material compatibility constraints make conventional top-down fabrication processes insufficient for such heterogeneous integration. Here, we report direct writing of perovskite quantum dots (QDs) with individual-emitter resolution. By inducing a nanoscale-confined formation volume using a thermal scanning probe method, we achieve site-selective synthesis down to a single atomic-scale QD with spectral tunability and < 25 nm spatial control. As a result, we demonstrate high-yield arrays of CsPbI3 single-photon emitters with narrow linewidths and high single-photon purity up to 98% at room temperature, performance consistent with that of their state-of-the-art colloidal counterparts. Through such deterministic control, we uniquely realize the precise, on-demand coupling of these emitters to photonic cavities, as evidenced by a measured enhancement in the spontaneous emission rate. This represents a key advancement toward addressing the longstanding integration obstacles of these materials. Overall, by combining the atomic-scale tunability of chemical synthesis with the spatial control of additive manufacturing, our work opens new emitter engineering strategies to realize the untapped potential of colloidal materials for next-generation quantum technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了一种利用热扫描探针方法直接写入钙钛矿量子点的方法，实现了单个发射体级别的空间控制（<25 nm），并展示了线宽窄、单光子纯度高达98%的CsPbI3单光子发射体阵列，以及它们与光子腔的确定性耦合。
AI.motivation: 无机卤化物钙钛矿纳米晶是很有前景的单光子源，但其在溶液中的随机分散性阻碍了单个发射体与光子结构的确定性和稳定集成，传统的自上而下加工方法因分辨率和材料兼容性限制而无法满足这种异质集成需求。
AI.method: 采用热扫描探针方法，在纳米尺度受限的形成体积内诱导位点选择性合成，实现了单个原子尺度量子点的直接写入，空间控制精度小于25 nm。
AI.result: 实现了CsPbI3单光子发射体的高产量阵列，具有窄线宽和室温下高达98%的单光子纯度；实现了这些发射体与光子腔的精确按需耦合，观测到自发发射速率的增强。
AI.conclusion: 通过将化学合成的原子尺度可调性与增材制造的空间控制相结合，本文为胶体材料在下一代量子技术中的应用开辟了新的发射体工程策略，解决了长期存在的集成障碍。
